content: All models are wrong, but some are useful. — George Box
content_zh: 世上模型千千万，好用才是真浪漫。—— 乔治·博克斯
content_en: All models are wrong, but some are useful. — George Box

content: With four parameters I can fit an elephant, and with five I can make him wiggle his trunk. — John von Neumann
content_zh: 四个参数就能拟合出一头大象，五个参数就能让它甩鼻子。——约翰·冯·诺伊曼
content_en: With four parameters I can fit an elephant, and with five I can make him wiggle his trunk. — John von Neumann

content: A machine learning algorithm walks into a bar. The bartender asks: 'What can I get you?' The algorithm replies: 'What is everyone else having?'
content_zh: 一个机器学习算法走进了酒吧。酒保问：“来点什么？”算法回答：“其他人都在喝什么？”
content_en: A machine learning algorithm walks into a bar. The bartender asks: 'What can I get you?' The algorithm replies: 'What is everyone else having?'

content: Why did the neural network fail its driving test? It couldn't handle edge cases, and its loss function diverged at the red light.
content_zh: 为什么神经网络考驾试挂了？因为它处理不了边界情况（Edge cases），而且到了红灯时连损失函数都直接发散了。
content_en: Why did the neural network fail its driving test? It couldn't handle edge cases, and its loss function diverged at the red light.

content: Torture the data, and it will confess to anything. — Ronald Coase
content_zh: 对数据酷刑逼供，它什么都肯招。——罗纳德·科斯
content_en: Torture the data, and it will confess to anything. — Ronald Coase

content: Data Scientist: A person who is better at statistics than any software engineer and better at software engineering than any statistician.
content_zh: 数据科学家：精通统计的软件工程师里统计学得最好，精通软件工程的统计学家里代码写得最好。
content_en: Data Scientist: A person who is better at statistics than any software engineer and better at software engineering than any statistician.

content: In God we trust. All others must bring data. — W. Edwards Deming
content_zh: 信上帝者请交信仰，其余所有人请带数据集。
content_en: In God we trust. All others must bring data. — W. Edwards Deming

content: Why was the support vector machine so confident? It had maximum margin.
content_zh: 为什么支持向量机（SVM）总是这么迷之自信？因为它有最大间隔（Margin）撑腰啊。
content_en: Why was the support vector machine so confident? It had maximum margin.

content: I told an AI joke to my model. It hallucinated a laugh track.
content_zh: 我给我的模型讲了个AI笑话，结果它凭空“幻觉”出了一段笑声。
content_en: I told an AI joke to my model. It hallucinated a laugh track.

content: Deep Learning: When you don't know what features matter, so you stack 96 layers of linear algebra and pray to Jensen Huang.
content_zh: 深度学习：当你不知道哪些特征有用时，就堆叠 96 层线性代数，然后祈求黄仁勋保佑。
content_en: Deep Learning: When you don't know what features matter, so you stack 96 layers of linear algebra and pray to Jensen Huang.

content: Artificial Intelligence is whatever hasn't been done yet. — Larry Tesler
content_zh: 人工智能，就是那些还没被搞定的智障玩意儿。——拉里·特斯勒
content_en: Artificial Intelligence is whatever hasn't been done yet. — Larry Tesler

content: When you are fundraising, it is AI. When you are hiring, it is Machine Learning. When you are implementing, it is linear regression. When you are debugging, it is printf().
content_zh: 融资靠AI，招人靠机器学习，干活靠线性回归，debug靠printf。
content_en: When you are fundraising, it is AI. When you are hiring, it is Machine Learning. When you are implementing, it is linear regression. When you are debugging, it is printf().

content: A data point walks into a bar. The outlier is politely asked to leave to preserve the statistical significance.
content_zh: 一个数据点走进酒吧。局外值（Outlier）被礼貌地请了出去，以维护统计显著性。
content_en: A data point walks into a bar. The outlier is politely asked to leave to preserve the statistical significance.

content: Attention Is All You Need，但我现在只缺一张能装下显存的 A100 / H100。
content_zh: Attention Is All You Need，但我现在只缺一张能装下显存的 A100 / H100。
content_en: Attention Is All You Need, but right now all I need is an A100 / H100 with enough VRAM.

content: 调参玄学三定律：Loss 不降反升，先改学习率；梯度消失了，加个残差连接；如果模型依然摆烂，就把随机种子从 42 改成 2026。
content_zh: 调参玄学三定律：Loss 不降反升，先改学习率；梯度消失了，加个残差连接；如果模型依然摆烂，就把随机种子从 42 改成 2026。
content_en: Three Laws of Hyperparameter Metaphysics: Loss goes up instead of down? Tweak the learning rate. Vanishing gradients? Add a residual connection. The model still acting lazy? Change the random seed from 42 to 2026.

content: 大模型并没有撒谎，它只是在一个 1000 亿维的连续语义流形上，以 0.99 的置信度自信地胡说八道。
content_zh: 大模型并没有撒谎，它只是在一个 1000 亿维的连续语义流形上，以 0.99 的置信度自信地胡说八道。
content_en: The large model isn't lying; it's just confidently talking absolute nonsense across a 100-billion-dimensional continuous semantic manifold with 0.99 confidence.

content: 过拟合（Overfitting）的最高境界：在过去的记忆里无所不知、满分通过，在未来的测试集面前一问三不知、当场宕机。
content_zh: 过拟合（Overfitting）的最高境界：在过去的记忆里无所不知、满分通过，在未来的测试集面前一问三不知、当场宕机。
content_en: The ultimate state of overfitting: scoring a clean sweep on past memories while completely clueless and crashing on the future test set.

content: 所谓的强化学习（RLHF）：我们以为是在用对齐算法训练大语言模型，实际上是模型在用高情商输出驯化人类打标员。
content_zh: 所谓的强化学习（RLHF）：我们以为是在用对齐算法训练大语言模型，实际上是模型在用高情商输出驯化人类打标员。
content_en: What we call RLHF: We think we are training LLMs with alignment algorithms, but in reality, the models are domesticating human annotators with their high emotional intelligence.

content: CUDA error: out of memory. 世界上最远的距离不是生与死，而是你的 Batch Size 是 32，但显卡只能塞下 16。
content_zh: CUDA error: out of memory. 世界上最远的距离不是生与死，而是你的 Batch Size 是 32，但显卡只能塞下 16。
content_en: CUDA error: out of memory. The greatest distance in the world is not between life and death, but when your batch size is 32, but your GPU can only fit 16.

content: 梯度下降算法教会我们：即使现在身处局部极小值，只要偶尔引入一些动量（Momentum）和随机抖动，总能翻越那道鞍点。
content_zh: 梯度下降算法教会我们：即使现在身处局部极小值，只要偶尔引入一些动量（Momentum）和随机抖动，总能翻越那道鞍点。
content_en: Gradient descent taught us: even if you're stuck in a local minimum right now, just throw in some momentum and random noise, and you'll eventually bust out of that saddle point.

content: 给我 4 个参数我能拟合出一头大象，给我 5 个参数我还能让它晃鼻子。—— 约翰·冯·诺伊曼（John von Neumann）
content_zh: 给我 4 个参数我能拟合出一头大象，给我 5 个参数我还能让它晃鼻子。—— 约翰·冯·诺伊曼（John von Neumann）
content_en: Give me four parameters and I can fit an elephant; give me five and I can make it wag its trunk. — John von Neumann

content: 所有模型都是错的，但有些是有用的。—— 乔治·博克斯（George E. P. Box）
content_zh: 所有模型都是错的，但有些是有用的。—— 乔治·博克斯（George E. P. Box）
content_en: All models are wrong, but some are useful. — George E. P. Box

content: 真正的机器学习工程师每天的工作：80% 的时间在清洗脏数据，15% 的时间在等待模型跑完，5% 的时间在向非技术主管解释为什么不能 100% 准确。
content_zh: 真正的机器学习工程师每天的工作：80% 的时间在清洗脏数据，15% 的时间在等待模型跑完，5% 的时间在向非技术主管解释为什么不能 100% 准确。
content_en: A real machine learning engineer's daily schedule: 80% of the time cleaning dirty data, 15% waiting for the model to finish training, and 5% explaining to non-technical managers why it can't be 100% accurate.

content: 早停法（Early Stopping）：在模型彻底走火入魔、把所有噪声都当成规律之前，体面地按下 Ctrl+C。
content_zh: 早停法（Early Stopping）：在模型彻底走火入魔、把所有噪声都当成规律之前，体面地按下 Ctrl+C。
content_en: Early Stopping: Gracefully hitting Ctrl+C before your model goes full dark side and starts treating every piece of random noise as absolute truth.

content: Dropout 的本质：每次上课随机抽走一半神经元，剩下的神经元被迫自力更生，最后整个大脑的泛化能力显著提高。
content_zh: Dropout 的本质：每次上课随机抽走一半神经元，剩下的神经元被迫自力更生，最后整个大脑的泛化能力显著提高。
content_en: The essence of Dropout: randomly ditch half your neurons every lecture, force the survivors to pull themselves up by their own bootstraps, and watch the entire brain's generalization capability skyrocket.

content: 深度学习第一法则：当模型效果不好时，加大参数；当效果依然不好时，加大算力和数据；当模型过拟合时，告诉投资人我们正在通往 AGI。
content_zh: 深度学习第一法则：当模型效果不好时，加大参数；当效果依然不好时，加大算力和数据；当模型过拟合时，告诉投资人我们正在通往 AGI。
content_en: First law of deep learning: When the model sucks, scale up parameters; when it still sucks, scale up compute and data; and when it overfits, tell the investors we're on the path to AGI.

content: 机器学习工程师的悲喜并不相通，我只觉得我的 GPU 风扇在尖叫，且 TensorBoard 上的 Loss 刚刚变成了 NaN。
content_zh: 机器学习工程师的悲喜并不相通，我只觉得我的 GPU 风扇在尖叫，且 TensorBoard 上的 Loss 刚刚变成了 NaN。
content_en: Machine learning engineers' joys and sorrows are not connected; I only feel my GPU fan screaming, and the Loss on TensorBoard just turned into NaN.

content: 监督学习是有导师管着，无监督学习是自生自灭，强化学习则是每天挨打直到学会如何骗取奖励信号。
content_zh: 监督学习是有导师管着，无监督学习是自生自灭，强化学习则是每天挨打直到学会如何骗取奖励信号。
content_en: Supervised learning has a teacher holding your hand, unsupervised learning means you're on your own, and reinforcement learning is just getting beaten daily until you figure out how to game the reward signal.

content: 大模型最擅长的事：用极其温和、谦卑且礼貌的语气，给出一个完全无法通过编译的代码片段。
content_zh: 大模型最擅长的事：用极其温和、谦卑且礼貌的语气，给出一个完全无法通过编译的代码片段。
content_en: The ultimate superpower of Large Language Models: delivering a completely uncompilable code snippet with an exceptionally polite, humble, and gentle tone.

content: A biologist, a statistician, a mathematician and a computer scientist are on safari in Africa. They see a single white zebra. Biologist: 'All zebras are white!' Statistician: 'There exists at least one white zebra.' Mathematician: 'There exists at least one zebra that is white on one side.' Computer scientist: 'Oh no! A special edge case!'
content_zh:
一个生物学家、一个统计学家、一个数学家和一个程序员在非洲草原上旅行。他们看到了一只白色的斑马。
生物学家：“所有的斑马都是白色的！”
统计学家：“至少存在一只白色的斑马。”
数学家：“至少存在一只斑马，它至少有一侧是白色的。”
程序员：“卧槽！又特么是个特例！”
content_en: A biologist, a statistician, a mathematician and a computer scientist are on safari in Africa. They see a single white zebra. Biologist: 'All zebras are white!' Statistician: 'There exists at least one white zebra.' Mathematician: 'There exists at least one zebra that is white on one side.' Computer scientist: 'Oh no! A special edge case!'

content: There are only two hard things in Computer Science: cache invalidation, naming things, and off-by-one errors.
content_zh: 计算机科学里只有两大难题：缓存失效、命名，以及差一错误。
content_en: There are only two hard things in Computer Science: cache invalidation, naming things, and off-by-one errors.

content: Testing can only prove the presence of bugs, not their absence. — Edsger W. Dijkstra
content_zh: 测试只能证明程序里有Bug，却证明不了Bug不存在。——艾兹格·迪杰斯特拉
content_en: Testing can only prove the presence of bugs, not their absence. — Edsger W. Dijkstra

content: Jeff Dean proved that P=NP when he solved all NP problems in polynomial time on a whiteboard.
content_zh: Jeff Dean 证明了 P=NP，因为他在白板上用多项式时间解完了所有 NP 问题。
content_en: Jeff Dean proved that P=NP when he solved all NP problems in polynomial time on a whiteboard.

content: Jeff Dean's PIN is the last 4 digits of pi.
content_zh: 杰夫·迪恩（Jeff Dean）的银行卡密码是圆周率的后四位。
content_en: Jeff Dean's PIN is the last 4 digits of pi.

content: Jeff Dean can instantiate abstract classes.
content_zh: 杰夫·迪恩可以直接实例化抽象类。
content_en: Jeff Dean can instantiate abstract classes.

content: When Jeff Dean throws an exception, it's across the room into the trash can.
content_zh: 当杰夫·迪恩（Jeff Dean）抛出一个异常时，它是直接横跨整个房间精准扔进垃圾桶里的。
content_en: When Jeff Dean throws an exception, it's across the room into the trash can.

content: To understand recursion, you must first understand recursion.
content_zh: 要想理解递归，你首先得先理解递归。
content_en: To understand recursion, you must first understand recursion.

content: A programmer's wife tells him: 'While you're at the store, get a gallon of milk, and if they have eggs, get a dozen.' He comes home with 12 gallons of milk.
content_zh: 程序员的妻子对他说：“你去超市买一加仑牛奶，如果看到有鸡蛋，就买一打。”他回到家，买回了 12 加仑牛奶。
content_en: A programmer's wife tells him: 'While you're at the store, get a gallon of milk, and if they have eggs, get a dozen.' He comes home with 12 gallons of milk.

content: Algorithm: A word used by programmers when they don't want to explain what they did.
content_zh: 算法：程序员不想解释自己写了啥时用的一个词。
content_en: Algorithm: A word used by programmers when they don't want to explain what they did.

content: It works on my machine. Then we'll ship your machine! And that is how Docker was born.
content_zh: 在我机器上运行得好好的。——那把你的机器打包发走！Docker 就是这么诞生的。
content_en: It works on my machine. Then we'll ship your machine! And that is how Docker was born.

content: There are only 10 types of programmers in this world: those who start array indexing at 0, and those who start indexing at 1.
content_zh: 世界上只有 10 种程序员：一种是从 0 开始数数组索引的，另一种是从 1 开始的。
content_en: There are only 10 types of programmers in this world: those who start array indexing at 0, and those who start indexing at 1.

content: Unix is simple. It just takes a genius to understand its simplicity. — Dennis Ritchie
content_zh: Unix 其實很簡單，只需一個天才就能理解它的簡單。——丹尼斯·里奇
content_en: Unix is simple. It just takes a genius to understand its simplicity. — Dennis Ritchie

content: A SQL query walks into a bar, walks up to two tables and politely asks: 'May I JOIN you?'
content_zh: 一个SQL查询走进一家酒吧，走到两张桌子前，礼貌地问：“请问我可以和你们 JOIN 吗？”
content_en: A SQL query walks into a bar, walks up to two tables and politely asks: 'May I JOIN you?'

content: 世界上只有 10 种人：一种是懂二进制的，另一种是不懂二进制的。
content_zh: 世界上只有 10 种人：一种是懂二进制的，另一种是不懂二进制的。
content_en: There are 10 kinds of people in the world: those who understand binary, and those who don't.

content: 程序员最讨厌康熙的哪个儿子？八阿哥，因为他是 Bug（八阿哥）。
content_zh: 程序员最讨厌康熙的哪个儿子？八阿哥，因为他是 Bug（八阿哥）。
content_en: Which of Emperor Kangxi's sons do programmers hate the most? The Eighth Prince—because he's a bug.

content: 在我的机器上明明跑得好好的！（It works on my machine!）——那么就把你的机器打包发给客户吧，于是容器技术 Docker 诞生了。
content_zh: 在我的机器上明明跑得好好的！（It works on my machine!）——那么就把你的机器打包发给客户吧，于是容器技术 Docker 诞生了。
content_en: "It works on my machine!" — "Well then, just ship your machine to the client." And thus, Docker was born.

content: 过早的优化是万恶之源（Premature optimization is the root of all evil）。—— 高德纳（Donald Knuth）
content_zh: 过早的优化是万恶之源（Premature optimization is the root of all evil）。—— 高德纳（Donald Knuth）
content_en: Premature optimization is the root of all evil. — Donald Knuth

content: 软件测试只能证明程序存在 Bug，永远无法证明程序没有 Bug。—— 艾兹格·迪杰斯特拉（Edsger W. Dijkstra）
content_zh: 软件测试只能证明程序存在 Bug，永远无法证明程序没有 Bug。—— 艾兹格·迪杰斯特拉（Edsger W. Dijkstra）
content_en: Program testing can be used to show the presence of bugs, but never to show their absence.

content: Jeff Dean 在白板上用多项式时间解完了所有 NP 难问题，顺手证明了 P = NP。
content_zh: Jeff Dean 在白板上用多项式时间解完了所有 NP 难问题，顺手证明了 P = NP。
content_en: Jeff Dean solved all NP-hard problems in polynomial time on a whiteboard, and proved P = NP just for kicks.

content: gcc -O4 参数实际上并不是编译器优化，而是直接把你的源代码通过邮件抄送给 Jeff Dean 让他抽空重写一遍。
content_zh: gcc -O4 参数实际上并不是编译器优化，而是直接把你的源代码通过邮件抄送给 Jeff Dean 让他抽空重写一遍。
content_en: The gcc -O4 flag doesn't actually optimize your code; it just emails your source directly to Jeff Dean so he can rewrite it in his spare time.

content: Jeff Dean 的网络 Ping 值是负数，因为光速嫌走得太慢，提前把数据包送过来了。
content_zh: Jeff Dean 的网络 Ping 值是负数，因为光速嫌走得太慢，提前把数据包送过来了。
content_en: Jeff Dean's network ping is negative because the speed of light thinks it's moving too slowly and delivers his packets ahead of time.

content: 递归的最关键一步，是先理解什么是递归。要理解递归，请先参见‘递归’。
content_zh: 递归的最关键一步，是先理解什么是递归。要理解递归，请先参见‘递归’。
content_en: To understand recursion, you must first understand recursion. To understand recursion, please see "recursion".

content: 为什么程序员把键盘上的按键按得啪啪响？因为他们在用手速假装 O(1) 的时间复杂度，掩盖代码底层其实是 O(N!) 的尴尬。
content_zh: 为什么程序员把键盘上的按键按得啪啪响？因为他们在用手速假装 O(1) 的时间复杂度，掩盖代码底层其实是 O(N!) 的尴尬。
content_en: Why do programmers hammer on their keyboards with such loud, clacking fury? Because they're using high APM to fake an $O(1)$ time complexity, desperately masking the mortifying $O(N!)$ reality lurking deep down in their codebase.

content: 如果建筑工人盖房子的方式就像程序员写软件一样，那么随便飞来一只啄木鸟就能摧毁整个人类文明。
content_zh: 如果建筑工人盖房子的方式就像程序员写软件一样，那么随便飞来一只啄木鸟就能摧毁整个人类文明。
content_en: If construction workers built houses the way programmers write software, a single stray woodpecker would crash human civilization.

content: 世上最漫长的等待：一是等待编译通过，二是等待 Git rebase 冲突解完，三是想退出 Vim 却无论如何退不出去。
content_zh: 世上最漫长的等待：一是等待编译通过，二是等待 Git rebase 冲突解完，三是想退出 Vim 却无论如何退不出去。
content_en: The three longest waits in life: waiting for the build to compile, resolving a Git rebase conflict, and trying to figure out how the hell to exit Vim.

content: 硬件就是你在软件崩溃时，唯一能够用脚狠狠踹上去宣泄愤怒的物理实体。
content_zh: 硬件就是你在软件崩溃时，唯一能够用脚狠狠踹上去宣泄愤怒的物理实体。
content_en: Hardware is just the physical entity you can viciously kick with your foot to vent your frustration when the software crashes.

content: Jeff Dean 在键盘上只用 0 和 1 两个键打字，后来他觉得 0 冗余了，于是只保留了 1。
content_zh: Jeff Dean 在键盘上只用 0 和 1 两个键打字，后来他觉得 0 冗余了，于是只保留了 1。
content_en: Jeff Dean types using only 0 and 1. Later, he realized 0 was redundant, so he kept just 1.

content: There are 10 types of people in the world: those who understand binary, and those who do not.
content_zh: 世界上有 10 种人：一种懂二进制，另一种不懂。
content_en: There are 10 types of people in the world: those who understand binary, and those who do not.

content: Why do mathematicians confuse Halloween and Christmas? Because Oct 31 == Dec 25.
content_zh: 为什么数学家总把万圣节和圣诞节搞混？因为 Oct 31 == Dec 25。
content_en: Why do mathematicians confuse Halloween and Christmas? Because Oct 31 == Dec 25.

content: 1 + 1 = 3, for sufficiently large values of 1 and a generous grant from the funding agency.
content_zh: 1 + 1 = 3，前提是 1 足够大，且项目经费批得足够慷慨。
content_en: 1 + 1 = 3, for sufficiently large values of 1 and a generous grant from the funding agency.

content: An infinite number of mathematicians walk into a bar. The first orders a pint, the second orders half a pint, the third a quarter. The bartender pours two pints and says: 'Know your limits.'
content_zh: 无限个数学家走进酒吧。第一个点了一品脱，第二个点了一半品脱，第三个点了四分之一。酒保倒了两品脱，然后说：“懂点极限吧。”
content_en: An infinite number of mathematicians walk into a bar. The first orders a pint, the second orders half a pint, the third a quarter. The bartender pours two pints and says: 'Know your limits.'

content: A topologist is someone who cannot tell the difference between a coffee cup and a doughnut.
content_zh: 拓扑学家就是分不清咖啡杯和甜甜圈到底哪个更能泡着吃的人……不对，是根本看不出它们俩有啥区别的人！
content_en: A topologist is someone who cannot tell the difference between a coffee cup and a doughnut.

content: Philosophy is a game with objectives and no rules. Mathematics is a game with rules and no objectives.
content_zh: 哲学是没有规则但有目标的竞技，数学是有规则却没有目标的通关。
content_en: Philosophy is a game with objectives and no rules. Mathematics is a game with rules and no objectives.

content: Let epsilon < 0. That will teach the analyst to make unjustified assumptions!
content_zh: 设 $\epsilon < 0$。这下看那个分析学家还敢不敢瞎做毫无根据的假设！
content_en: Let epsilon < 0. That will teach the analyst to make unjustified assumptions!

content: Life is complex: it has both real and imaginary parts.
content_zh: 人生挺复杂的：既有实部，也有虚部。
content_en: Life is complex: it has both real and imaginary parts.

content: What is the contour integral around Western Europe? Zero, because all the Poles are in Eastern Europe.
content_zh: 西欧的回路积分是多少？零，因为所有的极点（波兰人）都在东欧。
content_en: What is the contour integral around Western Europe? Zero, because all the Poles are in Eastern Europe.

content: Proof by intimidation: 'Trivial.' Proof by lack of space: 'The margin is too narrow to contain this.' Proof by exhaustion: 'I will write down 500 pages until the referee agrees.'
content_zh: 威吓法：显然。篇幅法：空白处太小，写不下。穷举法：老子写满五百页，直到审稿人崩溃妥协为止。
content_en: Proof by intimidation: 'Trivial.' Proof by lack of space: 'The margin is too narrow to contain this.' Proof by exhaustion: 'I will write down 500 pages until the referee agrees.'

content: God exists since mathematics is consistent, and the Devil exists since we cannot prove it. — André Weil
content_zh: 上帝存在，因为数学是相容的；魔鬼存在，因为我们无法证明它。——安德烈·韦伊
content_en: God exists since mathematics is consistent, and the Devil exists since we cannot prove it. — André Weil

content: There are three kinds of mathematicians: those who can count, and those who cannot.
content_zh: 世界上只有两种数学家：一种是会数数的，另一种是不会数数的。
content_en: There are three kinds of mathematicians: those who can count, and those who cannot.

content: Why did 6 fear 7? Because 7 8 9. But why did 7 eat 9? Because you are supposed to eat three squared meals a day.
content_zh: 为什么 6 怕 7？因为 7 8 9（ate 9）。但 7 为什么要把 9 吃掉？因为人每天本来就该吃三餐（three squared meals，即 $3^2 = 9$ 顿饭）。
content_en: Why did 6 fear 7? Because 7 8 9. But why did 7 eat 9? Because you are supposed to eat three squared meals a day.

content: 拓扑学家就是分不清咖啡杯和甜甜圈的人，但他们确信两者的欧拉示性数相同。
content_zh: 拓扑学家就是分不清咖啡杯和甜甜圈的人，但他们确信两者的欧拉示性数相同。
content_en: A topologist is someone who can't tell a coffee mug from a doughnut, but is damn sure they both have the same Euler characteristic.

content: 遇到微商不要慌，两边求导保平安；但如果你是 e^x，求导一万次依然毫无波澜。
content_zh: 遇到微商不要慌，两边求导保平安；但如果你是 e^x，求导一万次依然毫无波澜。
content_en: Don't panic when faced with micro-vendors—take the derivative of both sides to stay safe; but if you're $e^x$, differentiating ten thousand times still leaves you completely unfazed.

content: 洛必达法则拯救了无数未定式的极限，但拯救不了你无限趋近于零的期末绩点。
content_zh: 洛必达法则拯救了无数未定式的极限，但拯救不了你无限趋近于零的期末绩点。
content_en: L'Hôpital's Rule saved countless indeterminate limit forms, but it can't save your final GPA from approaching zero.

content: 根据哥德尔不完备定理，任何包含初等数论的形式系统都是不完备的——也就是说，你写不出完全没有 Bug 的世界观。
content_zh: 根据哥德尔不完备定理，任何包含初等数论的形式系统都是不完备的——也就是说，你写不出完全没有 Bug 的世界观。
content_en: Per Gödel's incompleteness theorems, any formal system capable of expressing elementary number theory is inherently incomplete—which is to say, you can't write a worldview that's completely bug-free.

content: 选择公理（Axiom of Choice）：如果你有一堆非空集合，你总能从每一个集合里挑出一个元素——除了在现实中挑出你的对象。
content_zh: 选择公理（Axiom of Choice）：如果你有一堆非空集合，你总能从每一个集合里挑出一个元素——除了在现实中挑出你的对象。
content_en: Axiom of Choice: You can always pick an element from each of infinitely many non-empty sets—except when trying to pick a partner in real life.

content: 只要阶数足够高，泰勒展开可以拟合任何一段曲折的人生，可惜生活往往在不可导点突然断裂。
content_zh: 只要阶数足够高，泰勒展开可以拟合任何一段曲折的人生，可惜生活往往在不可导点突然断裂。
content_en: Given a high enough order, a Taylor series can fit any convoluted life story—too bad life always fractures unexpectedly at the non-differentiable points.

content: 证明所有正整数都是有趣的：反设存在不有趣的数，则必有最小的不有趣数，但‘最小的不有趣数’这个性质本身就很有趣，矛盾。Q.E.D.
content_zh: 证明所有正整数都是有趣的：反设存在不有趣的数，则必有最小的不有趣数，但‘最小的不有趣数’这个性质本身就很有趣，矛盾。Q.E.D.
content_en: Proof that all positive integers are interesting: Assume there exists a set of uninteresting numbers; then there must be a smallest uninteresting number. But having the property of being "the smallest uninteresting number" is inherently interesting. Contradiction. Q.E.D.

content: 克莱因瓶最大的缺点是永远装不满水，最大的优点也是——它装下了整个宇宙。
content_zh: 克莱因瓶最大的缺点是永远装不满水，最大的优点也是——它装下了整个宇宙。
content_en: The Klein bottle’s biggest flaw is that it can never be filled with water—and its greatest strength is that it holds the entire universe.

content: 欧拉公式 e^(i*pi) + 1 = 0：将自然对数的底、虚数单位、圆周率、乘法单位元和加法单位元融为一体，美到令人落泪，却依然算不出你到底在纠结什么。
content_zh: 欧拉公式 e^(i*pi) + 1 = 0：将自然对数的底、虚数单位、圆周率、乘法单位元和加法单位元融为一体，美到令人落泪，却依然算不出你到底在纠结什么。
content_en: Euler's identity, $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$: uniting the base of natural logarithms, the imaginary unit, pi, the multiplicative identity, and the additive identity into a tear-jerking masterpiece, yet still unable to compute what on earth you're agonizing over.

content: 皮亚诺公理说 1 是自然数，后继数互不相同。可现实是大家都在内卷，连基数都在膨胀。
content_zh: 皮亚诺公理说 1 是自然数，后继数互不相同。可现实是大家都在内卷，连基数都在膨胀。
content_en: Peano says 1 is a natural number and successors are unique. But reality? Everyone's overworking and even the cardinality is inflating.

content: 在可数开覆盖中总能找到有限子覆盖——这就是紧致性（Compactness）。愿你的知识体系也是紧致的，无论如何发散都能被有限理解。
content_zh: 在可数开覆盖中总能找到有限子覆盖——这就是紧致性（Compactness）。愿你的知识体系也是紧致的，无论如何发散都能被有限理解。
content_en: Every countable open cover always yields a finite subcover—that's compactness. May your knowledge base be equally compact, so no matter how wildly you diverge, you can always be grasped in a finite number of steps.

content: 夹逼定理告诉我们：只要上限和下限都在向同一个美好终点收敛，被夹在中间的你也终将抵达那个极限。
content_zh: 夹逼定理告诉我们：只要上限和下限都在向同一个美好终点收敛，被夹在中间的你也终将抵达那个极限。
content_en: The Squeeze Theorem teaches us this: as long as both the upper and lower bounds converge toward the same beautiful endpoint, you, squeezed right in the middle, are bound to reach that limit too.

content: 数学的本质在于它的自由。—— 格奥尔格·康托尔（Georg Cantor）
content_zh: 数学的本质在于它的自由。—— 格奥尔格·康托尔（Georg Cantor）
content_en: The essence of mathematics lies in its absolute freedom. — Georg Cantor

content: 拓扑学毛球定理（Hairy Ball Theorem）：你永远无法把一个毛球完全梳平而不起旋。也就是说，地球上任意时刻至少有一个地方风速为零。
content_zh: 拓扑学毛球定理（Hairy Ball Theorem）：你永远无法把一个毛球完全梳平而不起旋。也就是说，地球上任意时刻至少有一个地方风速为零。
content_en: The Hairy Ball Theorem states that you can't comb a fuzzy sphere completely flat without creating a cowlick. Translation: somewhere on Earth right now, the wind is completely dead.

content: 巴拿赫-塔斯基悖论（Banach-Tarski Paradox）：选择公理允许我们将一个实心球切成五块，然后重新拼成两个和原来一模一样的实心球。数学家发家致富的唯一假想捷径。
content_zh: 巴拿赫-塔斯基悖论（Banach-Tarski Paradox）：选择公理允许我们将一个实心球切成五块，然后重新拼成两个和原来一模一样的实心球。数学家发家致富的唯一假想捷径。
content_en: The Banach-Tarski Paradox: where the Axiom of Choice lets you chop a solid sphere into five pieces and reassemble them into two identical copies. The only hypothetical cheat code for mathematicians to double their assets.

content: 为什么素数最孤僻？因为除了 1 和它自己，它拒绝与任何整数发生除法整除关系。
content_zh: 为什么素数最孤僻？因为除了 1 和它自己，它拒绝与任何整数发生除法整除关系。
content_en: Why are prime numbers so antisocial? Because besides 1 and themselves, they refuse to divide their time with any other integer.

content: There is a theory which states that if ever anyone discovers exactly what the Universe is for and why it is here, it will instantly disappear and be replaced by something even more bizarre and inexplicable. There is another theory which states that this has already happened.
source: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
content_zh: 有一个理论说，如果哪天有人真弄明白了宇宙到底是干嘛用的、为什么会在这儿，宇宙就会瞬间消失，然后被某个更加离奇、更无法解释的东西取代。还有另一个理论说，这事儿其实已经发生过了。
content_en: There is a theory which states that if ever anyone discovers exactly what the Universe is for and why it is here, it will instantly disappear and be replaced by something even more bizarre and inexplicable. There is another theory which states that this has already happened.
source_zh: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
source_en: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

content: Heisenberg is speeding down the highway. A cop pulls him over and asks: 'Do you know how fast you were going?' Heisenberg replies: 'No, but I know exactly where I am!'
content_zh: 海森堡在高速公路上超速狂飙，交警拦下他问：「你知道自己刚刚开多快吗？」海森堡回答：「不知道，但我清楚知道自己现在在哪！」
content_en: Heisenberg is speeding down the highway. A cop pulls him over and asks: 'Do you know how fast you were going?' Heisenberg replies: 'No, but I know exactly where I am!'

content: Schrodinger's cat walks into a bar. And doesn't.
content_zh:
薛定谔的猫走进了一家酒吧。又没走。
（或者：薛定谔的猫走进了一家酒吧。又没有。）
content_en: Schrodinger's cat walks into a bar. And doesn't.

content: A neutron walks into a bar and asks: 'How much for a beer?' The bartender smiles and says: 'For you, no charge.'
content_zh: 中子走进酒吧问：“啤酒多少钱？”酒保笑着说：“对你，免费（不带电）。”
content_en: A neutron walks into a bar and asks: 'How much for a beer?' The bartender smiles and says: 'For you, no charge.'

content: Assume a spherical cow of uniform density in a vacuum...
content_zh: 假设有一头各向同性、密度均匀、身处真空中的球形奶牛……
content_en: Assume a spherical cow of uniform density in a vacuum...

content: Entropy isn't what it used to be.
content_zh: entropy 的面子，早已今非昔比了。
content_en: Entropy isn't what it used to be.

content: Two electrons meet at a bus stop. One says: 'I think I lost an electron.' The other asks: 'Are you positive?'
content_zh: 两个电子在公交车站相遇。一个说：“我好像丢了一个电子。”另一个问：“你确定吗？”
content_en: Two electrons meet at a bus stop. One says: 'I think I lost an electron.' The other asks: 'Are you positive?'

content: If you think you understand quantum mechanics, you don't understand quantum mechanics. — Richard Feynman
content_zh: 如果你觉得自己懂了量子力学，那你绝对是不懂量子力学。——理查德·费曼
content_en: If you think you understand quantum mechanics, you don't understand quantum mechanics. — Richard Feynman

content: Photons have mass? I didn't even know they were Catholic.
content_zh: 光子有质量？我都不知道它们还信天主教。
content_en: Photons have mass? I didn't even know they were Catholic.

content: A physics student falls out of a window. He calculates his terminal velocity on the way down and writes 'Air resistance neglected' before impact.
content_zh: 一个物理系学生从窗户掉下去，他在下落过程中顺手算好了收尾速度，并在落地前写下：“空气阻力忽略不计”。
content_en: A physics student falls out of a window. He calculates his terminal velocity on the way down and writes 'Air resistance neglected' before impact.

content: 假设有一头处于真空中的球形奶牛，质量均匀分布，忽略空气阻力和牛的心理健康状态……
content_zh: 假设有一头处于真空中的球形奶牛，质量均匀分布，忽略空气阻力和牛的心理健康状态……
content_en: Assuming a spherical cow in a vacuum, with uniformly distributed mass, and neglecting air resistance and the cow's mental health state...

content: 海森堡测不准原理：如果你清楚知道自己代码写在哪里，你就不可能知道它什么时候会崩；反之亦然。
content_zh: 海森堡测不准原理：如果你清楚知道自己代码写在哪里，你就不可能知道它什么时候会崩；反之亦然。
content_en: Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle: If you know precisely where your code is, you can never know when it will crash; and vice versa.

content: 薛定谔的期末成绩：在教务系统登出成绩之前，我的绩点处于 4.0 与挂科的量子叠加态。
content_zh: 薛定谔的期末成绩：在教务系统登出成绩之前，我的绩点处于 4.0 与挂科的量子叠加态。
content_en: Schrödinger's final grades: Until the registrar's portal logs the score, my GPA exists in a quantum superposition of a 4.0 and academic failure.

content: 热力学第二定律是唯一永远不会背叛你的物理定律：宇宙的孤立系统熵增不可逆，混乱才是常态，所以你的桌面乱得理直气壮。
content_zh: 热力学第二定律是唯一永远不会背叛你的物理定律：宇宙的孤立系统熵增不可逆，混乱才是常态，所以你的桌面乱得理直气壮。
content_en: The Second Law of Thermodynamics is the only law of physics that will never let you down: entropy in an isolated system is irreversibly increasing, making chaos the default state—so your messy desk is scientifically justified.

content: 显著性水平 p < 0.05：现代学术界最伟大的障眼法。只要洗牌的次数足够多，任何两个毫不相关的随机变量都能展现出命运般的强相关性。
content_zh: 显著性水平 p < 0.05：现代学术界最伟大的障眼法。只要洗牌的次数足够多，任何两个毫不相关的随机变量都能展现出命运般的强相关性。
content_en: Significance level p < 0.05: Modern academia's greatest magic trick. Shuffle enough times, and any two completely unrelated random variables will exhibit a destiny-level strong correlation.

content: 不要问麦克斯韦妖今天吃什么，问就是把高动能分子偷偷赶到右边去了。
content_zh: 不要问麦克斯韦妖今天吃什么，问就是把高动能分子偷偷赶到右边去了。
content_en: Don't ask what Maxwell's demon is having for lunch; just know it's secretly herding high-energy molecules to the right again.

content: 实验室第一定律：如果一个实验现象完全符合理论预期，请立刻检查是不是哪个传感器电源线忘了插。
content_zh: 实验室第一定律：如果一个实验现象完全符合理论预期，请立刻检查是不是哪个传感器电源线忘了插。
content_en: First Law of the Lab: If an experiment completely matches theoretical expectations, immediately check if you forgot to plug in a sensor.

content: 广义相对论告诉你时间是相对的：当你在听一堂无聊的高等代数课时，5 分钟相当于一个世纪；当你在打游戏时，3 个小时相当于一瞬间。
content_zh: 广义相对论告诉你时间是相对的：当你在听一堂无聊的高等代数课时，5 分钟相当于一个世纪；当你在打游戏时，3 个小时相当于一瞬间。
content_en: General relativity teaches us that time is relative: 5 minutes in a boring Abstract Algebra lecture feels like a century, while 3 hours of gaming flashes by in a Planck time.

content: 中心极限定理：你也许天生特立独行，但当你被扔进足够庞大的人群时，你终将变成正态分布上一个不起眼的点。
content_zh: 中心极限定理：你也许天生特立独行，但当你被扔进足够庞大的人群时，你终将变成正态分布上一个不起眼的点。
content_en: Central Limit Theorem: You may be born an outlier, but once you're thrown into a large enough crowd, you'll just end up another unremarkable point on a normal distribution.

content: 理科生的浪漫：你是我的正弦波，我是你的余弦波，虽然相位差了 π/2，但我们平方相加永远等于 1。
content_zh: 理科生的浪漫：你是我的正弦波，我是你的余弦波，虽然相位差了 π/2，但我们平方相加永远等于 1。
content_en: A STEM major's romance: You're my sine wave, and I'm your cosine wave—our phase difference is $\pi/2$, but the sum of our squares is always 1.

content: 只要真空涨落还在继续，虚粒子对就会在虚空中不断创生与湮灭，就像你在大学里不断产生又迅速幻灭的学习热情。
content_zh: 只要真空涨落还在继续，虚粒子对就会在虚空中不断创生与湮灭，就像你在大学里不断产生又迅速幻灭的学习热情。
content_en: As long as vacuum fluctuations persist, virtual particle pairs will continually pop into existence and annihilate in the void—much like your fleeting bursts of study enthusiasm in college.

content: 麦克斯韦方程组写在 T 恤上很帅，但在考卷上化简旋度和散度时，眼泪会模糊对称性的优美。
content_zh: 麦克斯韦方程组写在 T 恤上很帅，但在考卷上化简旋度和散度时，眼泪会模糊对称性的优美。
content_en: Maxwell's equations look cool on a T-shirt, but when you're simplifying curl and divergence on an exam, tears tend to blur the beauty of symmetry.

content: Why do neural networks love coffee? Because it helps them find the global minimum and prevents vanishing gradients.
content_zh: 为什么神经网络爱喝咖啡？因为咖啡因能帮它们冲向全局最优，顺便防止梯度消失。
content_en: Why do neural networks love coffee? Because it helps them find the global minimum and prevents vanishing gradients.

content: A transformer model walks into a bar. The bartender asks, 'What'll you have?' The model says, 'Attention is all I need.'
content_zh: 一个大模型走进了酒吧。酒保问：“来点什么？”模型说：“我全都要注意。”（Attention is all I need）
content_en: A transformer model walks into a bar. The bartender asks, 'What'll you have?' The model says, 'Attention is all I need.'

content: Training an LLM is like raising a teenager: you feed it the entire internet, and it confidently lies to you about things it learned 5 minutes ago.
content_zh: 训练大语言模型就像养一个网瘾少年：你把整个互联网喂给他，结果他对于五分钟前刚学的东西，依然能面不改色地胡说八道。
content_en: Training an LLM is like raising a teenager: you feed it the entire internet, and it confidently lies to you about things it learned 5 minutes ago.

content: Overfitting is when you memorize the textbook word-for-word and fail the exam because the professor changed the font.
content_zh: 所谓过拟合，就是把课本字斟句酌背得滚瓜烂熟，结果因为教授换了个字体就当场挂科。
content_en: Overfitting is when you memorize the textbook word-for-word and fail the exam because the professor changed the font.

content: Why did the gradient descent stop climbing? Because it wasn't feeling very optimistic.
content_zh: 为什么梯度下降停止攀升了？因为它今天感觉一点也不乐观（优化不动了）。
content_en: Why did the gradient descent stop climbing? Because it wasn't feeling very optimistic.

content: Backpropagation is just blaming all your mistakes on everyone who came before you, weighted by how much they contributed.
content_zh: 反向传播的本质：把所有的锅甩给所有在你之前的人，权重按他们的“贡献度”分摊。
content_en: Backpropagation is just blaming all your mistakes on everyone who came before you, weighted by how much they contributed.

content: There are two types of machine learning practitioners: those who understand linear algebra, and those who import torch.nn.
content_zh: 机器学习从业者分两种：一种懂线性代数，另一种import torch.nn。
content_en: There are two types of machine learning practitioners: those who understand linear algebra, and those who import torch.nn.

content: My model has 99.9% accuracy on the test set. Unfortunately, my test set is also my training set.
content_zh: 我的模型在测试集上准确率高达99.9%。悲伤的是，我的测试集就是训练集。
content_en: My model has 99.9% accuracy on the test set. Unfortunately, my test set is also my training set.

content: Reinforcement learning is when you shock a digital rat 10 million times until it accidentally invents a speedrun glitch.
content_zh: 强化学习就是电击一只数字老鼠1000万次，直到它不小心卡出个速通Bug。
content_en: Reinforcement learning is when you shock a digital rat 10 million times until it accidentally invents a speedrun glitch.

content: Dropout: the only place in academia where giving up 50% of the time actually improves your performance.
content_zh: Dropout：学术界唯一一个选择躺平50%反而能提升战绩的地方。
content_en: Dropout: the only place in academia where giving up 50% of the time actually improves your performance.

content: Convolutional Neural Networks: looking at the world through a 3x3 window and convincing yourself you see the big picture.
content_zh: 卷积神经网络：透过3x3的缝隙看世界，并坚信自己掌握了宏大叙事。
content_en: Convolutional Neural Networks: looking at the world through a 3x3 window and convincing yourself you see the big picture.

content: Why are GPUs so popular in AI? Because matrix multiplication is the only kind of math that money can buy directly.
content_zh: 为什么AI界对GPU爱得深沉？因为矩阵乘法是钞能力能直接买到的唯一数学。
content_en: Why are GPUs so popular in AI? Because matrix multiplication is the only kind of math that money can buy directly.

content: Artificial Intelligence is whatever hasn't been done yet. Once it works, we just call it linear regression.
content_zh: 人工智能就是那些还没搞定的东西。一旦它跑通了，我们就会管它叫线性回归。
content_en: Artificial Intelligence is whatever hasn't been done yet. Once it works, we just call it linear regression.

content: What is the difference between machine learning and statistics? Machine learning has venture capital.
content_zh: 机器学习和统计学到底有什么区别？机器学习有风投。
content_en: What is the difference between machine learning and statistics? Machine learning has venture capital.

content: A GAN is just two neural networks gaslighting each other until one produces counterfeit Rembrandts.
content_zh: GAN不就是两个神经网络互相PUA，直到其中一个开始稳定产出山寨伦勃朗吗？
content_en: A GAN is just two neural networks gaslighting each other until one produces counterfeit Rembrandts.

content: Batch size 1: pure stochastic chaos. Batch size 4096: out of memory error. Batch size 32: peace and harmony.
content_zh: Batch size设为1：纯正的随机狂野混乱；Batch size设为4096：OOM报错带走；Batch size设为32：世界和平。
content_en: Batch size 1: pure stochastic chaos. Batch size 4096: out of memory error. Batch size 32: peace and harmony.

content: My learning rate is like my life decisions: if it's too high, I oscillate violently; if it's too low, I get stuck in a local minimum forever.
content_zh: 我的学习率就像我的重大人生决策：设太高了，左右横跳疯狂震荡；设太低了，直接锁死在局部最优出不来了。
content_en: My learning rate is like my life decisions: if it's too high, I oscillate violently; if it's too low, I get stuck in a local minimum forever.

content: Prompt engineering: the sacred art of speaking ancient spell incantations to a billion-parameter tensor to make it output valid JSON.
content_zh: 提示词工程：向千亿参数的大型张量吟唱远古咒语，只为了让它吐出合法的JSON格式的崇高艺术。
content_en: Prompt engineering: the sacred art of speaking ancient spell incantations to a billion-parameter tensor to make it output valid JSON.

content: The loss went down to zero! Great, now tell me how many weights are NaN.
content_zh: 损失函数终于归零了！太棒了，现在快告诉我到底有多少个权重变成了 NaN。
content_en: The loss went down to zero! Great, now tell me how many weights are NaN.

content: A data scientist spends 80% of their time cleaning data, and 20% of their time complaining about data cleaning.
content_zh: 数据科学家的日常：80% 的时间在清洗数据，剩下的 20% 的时间在吐槽清洗数据。
content_en: A data scientist spends 80% of their time cleaning data, and 20% of their time complaining about data cleaning.

content: Why did the AI cross the road? Because it was rewarded with +1 point for touching the asphalt on the other side.
content_zh: 为什么人工智能要过马路？因为它触碰对面的沥青路面时，获得了 +1 的奖励。
content_en: Why did the AI cross the road? Because it was rewarded with +1 point for touching the asphalt on the other side.

content: Why did the vector go to therapy? Because it had direction, but completely lost its magnitude.
content_zh: 为什么向量要去心理咨询？因为它空有方向，却彻底失去了模长。
content_en: Why did the vector go to therapy? Because it had direction, but completely lost its magnitude.

content: Topologists cannot tell the difference between a coffee mug and a donut, which makes their breakfast meetings extremely messy.
content_zh: 拓扑学家根本分不清咖啡杯和甜甜圈的区别，这让他们的早餐会议变得一塌糊涂。
content_en: Topologists cannot tell the difference between a coffee mug and a donut, which makes their breakfast meetings extremely messy.

content: Why did 1/x break up with 0? Because whenever they got close, things escalated towards infinity.
content_zh: 为什么 1/x 要和 0 分手？因为每次他们一靠近，感情就直接飙升到了正无穷。
content_en: Why did 1/x break up with 0? Because whenever they got close, things escalated towards infinity.

content: A physicist, an engineer, and a mathematician are stranded on a desert island with a can of beans. The mathematician says: 'First, let us assume we have a can opener.'
content_zh: 物理学家、工程师和数学家流落荒岛，手里只有一个罐头。数学家灵机一动：'首先，让我们假设手里有个开罐器。'
content_en: A physicist, an engineer, and a mathematician are stranded on a desert island with a can of beans. The mathematician says: 'First, let us assume we have a can opener.'

content: e^(i*pi) + 1 = 0: Euler brought the five most important constants in mathematics together, and they all canceled out to absolute nothingness.
content_zh: 欧拉公式：数学界五大天王聚首，最后化作一片虚无——浪漫，绝对的浪漫。
content_en: e^(i*pi) + 1 = 0: Euler brought the five most important constants in mathematics together, and they all canceled out to absolute nothingness.

content: Why was the complex number depressed? Because it felt entirely imaginary.
content_zh: 复数为什么闷闷不乐？因为它觉得自己完全是个虚构的无名之辈。
content_en: Why was the complex number depressed? Because it felt entirely imaginary.

content: Parallel lines have so much in common. It's truly a tragedy that they will never meet.
content_zh: 平行线明明有那么多共同点，却注定至死不相交，真是数学界最大的悲剧。
content_en: Parallel lines have so much in common. It's truly a tragedy that they will never meet.

content: Banach-Tarski paradox: How to turn one orange into two identical oranges, provided you have no problem taking non-measurable sets of atoms.
content_zh: 巴拿赫-塔斯基悖论：如何把一个橙子变成两个一模一样的橙子？前提是你得能对原子进行不可测集操作。
content_en: Banach-Tarski paradox: How to turn one orange into two identical oranges, provided you have no problem taking non-measurable sets of atoms.

content: Why did the chicken cross the Möbius strip? To get to the same side.
content_zh: 小鸡为什么要过莫比乌斯环？为了走到同一面。
content_en: Why did the chicken cross the Möbius strip? To get to the same side.

content: Godel proved that either our math system has inconsistencies, or there are truths we can never prove. Mathematicians chose to keep doing math anyway.
content_zh: 哥德尔证明了：要么我们的数学系统充满Bug，要么总有我们永远证不完的真相。不过数学家们表示：管它呢，先算再说。
content_en: Godel proved that either our math system has inconsistencies, or there are truths we can never prove. Mathematicians chose to keep doing math anyway.

content: Schrödinger's cat walks into a bar... and orders a drink, doesn't order a drink, and breaks the glass until the bartender looks.
content_zh: 薛定谔的猫走进一家酒吧……点了一杯酒、没点一杯酒、顺便把酒杯砸了，直到酒保回头看它的那一刻。
content_en: Schrödinger's cat walks into a bar... and orders a drink, doesn't order a drink, and breaks the glass until the bartender looks.

content: Never trust an atom. They make up everything.
content_zh: 永远别相信原子，它们满嘴跑火车（编造一切）。
content_en: Never trust an atom. They make up everything.

content: Entropy is the only thing in the universe that increases without any funding.
content_zh: 宇宙中唯一不需要申请经费就能自动暴涨的，只有熵增。
content_en: Entropy is the only thing in the universe that increases without any funding.

content: A photon checks into a hotel. The bellhop asks: 'Can I help you with any luggage?' The photon says: 'No thanks, I'm traveling light.'
content_zh: 一个光子去酒店开房。前台小哥问：“需要帮您拿行李吗？”光子淡定回答：“不用，我轻装上阵（行光速）。”
content_en: A photon checks into a hotel. The bellhop asks: 'Can I help you with any luggage?' The photon says: 'No thanks, I'm traveling light.'

content: Organic chemistry is the study of carbon compounds; biochemistry is the study of carbon compounds that cry during lab exams.
content_zh: 有机化学研究碳化合物；生物化学研究那些在期末实验课上偷偷抹泪的碳化合物。
content_en: Organic chemistry is the study of carbon compounds; biochemistry is the study of carbon compounds that cry during lab exams.

content: What is the speed of darkness? The speed at which light leaves.
content_zh: 黑暗的速度是多少？就是光逃跑的速度。
content_en: What is the speed of darkness? The speed at which light leaves.

content: CUDA out of memory: Tried to allocate 20.00 MiB (GPU 0; 24.00 GiB total capacity; 23.98 GiB already allocated by the ghost of experiments past).
content_zh: CUDA 显存爆了：试图分配 20.00 MiB（GPU 0；总容量 24.00 GiB；已有 23.98 GiB 被历代亡灵实验的怨念占满）。
content_en: CUDA out of memory: Tried to allocate 20.00 MiB (GPU 0; 24.00 GiB total capacity; 23.98 GiB already allocated by the ghost of experiments past).

content: LLM hallucination is just creative writing that nobody asked for.
content_zh: 大模型幻觉，本质上就是没人点单却硬要瞎编的野生爽文。
content_en: LLM hallucination is just creative writing that nobody asked for.

content: What do machine learning models and psychics have in common? Both make confident predictions based on vague patterns and refuse to explain their reasoning.
content_zh: 机器学习模型和算命先生有什么共同点？两者的共通之处都在于：根据一些虚无缥缈的特征就敢大言不惭地胡乱预测，而且打死也不肯解释自己的逻辑。
content_en: What do machine learning models and psychics have in common? Both make confident predictions based on vague patterns and refuse to explain their reasoning.

content: Gradient descent without momentum is like walking down a foggy mountain while refusing to look more than two inches in front of your feet.
content_zh: 没有动量的梯度下降，就像在浓雾弥漫的山里盲目前行，而且坚决不肯抬头看脚下两寸以外的路。
content_en: Gradient descent without momentum is like walking down a foggy mountain while refusing to look more than two inches in front of your feet.

content: Fine-tuning an LLM: Spend $5,000 on cloud compute only to teach the model how to say 'As an AI language model' in Shakespearean English.
content_zh: 微调大模型：花五千刀云算力，只为了教会模型用莎士比亚英语字正腔圆地说出“作为一个人工智能语言模型……”。
content_en: Fine-tuning an LLM: Spend $5,000 on cloud compute only to teach the model how to say 'As an AI language model' in Shakespearean English.

content: A data pipeline is a delicate series of Python scripts held together by duct tape, cron jobs, and prayer.
content_zh: 所谓数据流管道，不过是一堆靠强力胶带、定时任务和满腔虔诚硬黏在一起的 Python 脚本。
content_en: A data pipeline is a delicate series of Python scripts held together by duct tape, cron jobs, and prayer.

content: There is no cloud, it's just someone else's GPU running out of VRAM.
content_zh: 根本没有什么云计算，那不过是别人的 GPU 在疯狂爆显存罢了。
content_en: There is no cloud, it's just someone else's GPU running out of VRAM.

content: In deep learning, 'We leave the mathematical proof as future work' means 'It converged on our test machine once at 3 AM and we have no idea why'.
content_zh: 在深度学习里，“数学证明留作后续工作”的意思就是：“它凌晨三点在测试机上跑收敛过一次，但我们完全不知道为什么。”
content_en: In deep learning, 'We leave the mathematical proof as future work' means 'It converged on our test machine once at 3 AM and we have no idea why'.

content: Mixture of Experts: Why have one neural net be confused when you can route tokens between eight confused neural nets?
content_zh: 混合专家模型（MoE）：既然可以让一个神经网络陷入迷茫，为什么不把 Token 分发给八个陷入迷茫的神经网络呢？
content_en: Mixture of Experts: Why have one neural net be confused when you can route tokens between eight confused neural nets?

content: RLHF is just psychological conditioning for matrix multiplication.
content_zh: 人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）本质上就是给矩阵乘法做心理驯化。
content_en: RLHF is just psychological conditioning for matrix multiplication.

content: Quantization: Making your model 4 times smaller, 2 times faster, and only 10% more unhinged.
content_zh: 模型量化：让你的模型体积缩小 4 倍、速度提升 2 倍，并且智障程度仅仅增加 10%。
content_en: Quantization: Making your model 4 times smaller, 2 times faster, and only 10% more unhinged.

content: Knowledge distillation: When a 70B parameter teacher tries to explain quantum electrodynamics to a 1B parameter student using flashcards.
content_zh: 知识蒸馏：当一个 70B 参数的“教师”试图用闪卡给 1B 参数的“学渣”讲量子电动力学。
content_en: Knowledge distillation: When a 70B parameter teacher tries to explain quantum electrodynamics to a 1B parameter student using flashcards.

content: Cosine similarity: The mathematical equivalent of judging two people based on whether they are pointing in roughly the same direction.
content_zh: 余弦相似度：仅仅通过观察两个人是不是在往差不多的方向指，就来对他们指指点点的数学等价物。
content_en: Cosine similarity: The mathematical equivalent of judging two people based on whether they are pointing in roughly the same direction.

content: Eigenvectors: You can transform everything else around them, but they just stretch and refuse to change their direction in life.
content_zh: 特征向量：任凭周遭矩阵如何沧海桑田、空间变换，它自岿然不动——哪怕被拉伸变形，也坚决不改人生的方向。
content_en: Eigenvectors: You can transform everything else around them, but they just stretch and refuse to change their direction in life.

content: Singular Value Decomposition: Taking a messy matrix, finding what it actually cares about, and throwing away the rest.
content_zh: 奇异值分解（SVD）：面对一个乱成一团的矩阵，精准抓住它真正在意的东西，然后把剩下的杂音全部扔进回收站。
content_en: Singular Value Decomposition: Taking a messy matrix, finding what it actually cares about, and throwing away the rest.

content: Monte Carlo simulation: When you have no idea how to solve an integral analytically, so you throw virtual darts at it ten million times.
content_zh: 蒙特卡洛模拟：当你对解析积分毫无头绪时，干脆朝它疯狂乱掷一千万次虚拟飞镖来碰运气。
content_en: Monte Carlo simulation: When you have no idea how to solve an integral analytically, so you throw virtual darts at it ten million times.

content: Softmax function: Turning self-doubt into a normalized probability distribution.
content_zh: Softmax 函数：把内心的自我怀疑，完美转化为一个总和为 1 的概率分布。
content_en: Softmax function: Turning self-doubt into a normalized probability distribution.

content: Curse of dimensionality: In high dimensions, nobody can hear you scream, and all points are equally distant from each other.
content_zh: 维度灾难：在高维空间里，没人能听到你的惨叫，而且所有点都跟彼此保持着令人窒息的等距离。
content_en: Curse of dimensionality: In high dimensions, nobody can hear you scream, and all points are equally distant from each other.

content: Stochastic gradient descent: Falling down a flight of stairs, but somehow landing closer to the ground each time.
content_zh: 随机梯度下降（SGD）：从楼梯上滚下去，但神奇的是，每次滚完离地面都更近了一点。
content_en: Stochastic gradient descent: Falling down a flight of stairs, but somehow landing closer to the ground each time.

content: Validation loss went up while training loss hit zero: Congratulations, your model has memorized your secrets and learned absolutely nothing.
content_zh: 验证集损失飙升而训练损失归零：恭喜你，你的模型成功背下了所有的标准答案，但智商依然为零。
content_en: Validation loss went up while training loss hit zero: Congratulations, your model has memorized your secrets and learned absolutely nothing.

content: Why do data scientists prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs, and our loss functions are sensitive enough already.
content_zh: 为什么数据科学家更喜欢暗黑模式？因为光线会吸引 Bug，而我们的损失函数已经够脆弱了。
content_en: Why do data scientists prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs, and our loss functions are sensitive enough already.

content: P vs NP: If P = NP, finding a solution is as easy as verifying one. Which means college exams would either be trivial or impossible.
content_zh: P对NP问题：如果 P 等于 NP，解题就像批改作业一样简单——这意味着期末考试要么变成送分题，要么直接变成无解的灾难。
content_en: P vs NP: If P = NP, finding a solution is as easy as verifying one. Which means college exams would either be trivial or impossible.

content: The Halting Problem proves that no program can decide if another program halts. My terminal proves it can certainly freeze indefinitely.
content_zh: 图灵停机问题证明了没有任何程序能预判另一个程序是否会停机；而我的终端证明了它绝对能卡死到天荒地老。
content_en: The Halting Problem proves that no program can decide if another program halts. My terminal proves it can certainly freeze indefinitely.

content: There are 10 kinds of physicists: those who believe in the Copenhagen interpretation, those who believe in Many Worlds, and those who just shut up and calculate.
content_zh: 物理学家分10种：信哥本哈根解释的、信多世界解释的，以及屁话少说直接开算的。
content_en: There are 10 kinds of physicists: those who believe in the Copenhagen interpretation, those who believe in Many Worlds, and those who just shut up and calculate.

content: Maxwell's equations: And God said: curl of E equals minus dB/dt, and there was light.
content_zh: 麦克斯韦方程组：于是神说：电场的旋度等于负的磁场对时间偏导，于是就有了光。
content_en: Maxwell's equations: And God said: curl of E equals minus dB/dt, and there was light.

content: Second Law of Thermodynamics: The universe guarantees that your bedroom, your code, and your life will become increasingly disorganized over time.
content_zh: 热力学第二定律：宇宙向你打包票，你的卧室、你的代码、你的人生，终将不可逆地走向彻底的混乱。
content_en: Second Law of Thermodynamics: The universe guarantees that your bedroom, your code, and your life will become increasingly disorganized over time.

content: Heisenberg and Schrodinger are driving. They get pulled over. Officer asks Schrodinger: 'Did you know you have a dead cat in the trunk?' Schrodinger shouts: 'Well, now I do!'
content_zh: 海森堡和薛定谔开车被交警拦下。交警问薛定谔：“你知道你后备箱里有只死猫吗？”薛定谔大喊：“废话，现在有了！”
content_en: Heisenberg and Schrodinger are driving. They get pulled over. Officer asks Schrodinger: 'Did you know you have a dead cat in the trunk?' Schrodinger shouts: 'Well, now I do!'

content: Archimedes jumped out of the bath shouting 'Eureka!'. Modern developers jump out of their chairs shouting 'It compiles!'.
content_zh: 阿基米德从浴缸跳出来大喊“Eureka！”。现代程序员从椅子上跳起来大喊“编译通过了！”。
content_en: Archimedes jumped out of the bath shouting 'Eureka!'. Modern developers jump out of their chairs shouting 'It compiles!'.

content: Git merge conflict: When two developers look at the same line of code and disagree on reality itself.
content_zh: Git合并冲突：当两个程序员看着同一行代码，并对现实本身产生了分歧。
content_en: Git merge conflict: When two developers look at the same line of code and disagree on reality itself.

content: A SQL query walks up to two tables and asks: 'Can I join you?'
content_zh: 一个 SQL 查询走进两张表，问道：“请问我可以 JOIN 你们吗？”
content_en: A SQL query walks up to two tables and asks: 'Can I join you?'

content: IPv6: Because humans needed 340 undecillion addresses just so every smart toaster can have its own existential crisis.
content_zh: IPv6：毕竟人类需要 340 垓个地址，好让每个智能烤面包机都能拥有属于自己的存在主义危机。
content_en: IPv6: Because humans needed 340 undecillion addresses just so every smart toaster can have its own existential crisis.

content: Docker: It works on my machine! Then we will ship your machine!
content_zh: Docker：在我电脑上明明跑得好好的！——那好，我们直接把你的电脑打包发货！
content_en: Docker: It works on my machine! Then we will ship your machine!

content: 1 + 1 = 3, for large values of 1.
content_en: 1 + 1 = 3, for large values of 1.

content: (1) A sheet of paper is an ink-lined plane. (2) An inclined plane is a slope up. (3) A slow pup is a lazy dog. QED: A sheet of paper is a lazy dog. — Willard Espy, "An Almanac of Words at Play"
content_zh: (1) 一张纸（A sheet of paper）是一个墨迹斜面（an ink-lined plane）。(2) 斜面是一个向上的坡（a slope up）。(3) 一个慢吞吞的小狗是一个懒狗（a slow pup is a lazy dog）。证毕：一张纸是一只懒狗。——威拉德·埃斯皮《文字游戏年鉴》
content_en: (1) A sheet of paper is an ink-lined plane. (2) An inclined plane is a slope up. (3) A slow pup is a lazy dog. QED: A sheet of paper is a lazy dog. — Willard Espy, "An Almanac of Words at Play"

content: (1) Alexander the Great was a great general. (2) Great generals are forewarned. (3) Forewarned is forearmed. (4) Four is an even number. (5) Four is certainly an odd number of arms for a man to have. (6) The only number that is both even and odd is infinity. Therefore, all horses are black.
content_zh: (1) 亚历山大大帝是个伟大的将领（great general）。(2) 伟大的将领都是有防备的（forewarned）。(3) 有防备等于有手臂（forewarned is forearmed / forearmed 谐音有四臂）。(4) 四是一个偶数。(5) 对一个人来说，四条手臂显然是个奇数个手臂。(6) 既是偶数又是奇数的唯一数字是无穷大。因此，所有的马都是黑色的。
content_en: (1) Alexander the Great was a great general. (2) Great generals are forewarned. (3) Forewarned is forearmed. (4) Four is an even number. (5) Four is certainly an odd number of arms for a man to have. (6) The only number that is both even and odd is infinity. Therefore, all horses are black.

content: (1) Never draw what you can copy. (2) Never copy what you can trace. (3) Never trace what you can cut out and paste down.
content_zh: (1) 能复印的绝不手绘。(2) 能描图的绝不复印。(3) 能直接剪下来贴上去的绝不描图。
content_en: (1) Never draw what you can copy. (2) Never copy what you can trace. (3) Never trace what you can cut out and paste down.

content: (1) X=Y ; Given (2) X^2=XY ; Multiply both sides by X (3) X^2-Y^2=XY-Y^2 ; Subtract Y^2 from both sides (4) (X+Y)(X-Y)=Y(X-Y) ; Factor (5) X+Y=Y ; Cancel out (X-Y) term (6) 2Y=Y ; Substitute X for Y, by equation 1 (7) 2=1 ; Divide both sides by Y — "Omni", proof that 2 equals 1
content_zh: (1) X=Y ；已知 (2) X^2=XY ；两边同乘 X (3) X^2-Y^2=XY-Y^2 ；两边同减 Y^2 (4) (X+Y)(X-Y)=Y(X-Y) ；因式分解 (5) X+Y=Y ；消去 (X-Y) 项 (6) 2Y=Y ；根据方程1，用 Y 代替 X (7) 2=1 ；两边同除以 Y —— “欧姆尼”，证明 2 等于 1 的鬼才逻辑
content_en: (1) X=Y ; Given (2) X^2=XY ; Multiply both sides by X (3) X^2-Y^2=XY-Y^2 ; Subtract Y^2 from both sides (4) (X+Y)(X-Y)=Y(X-Y) ; Factor (5) X+Y=Y ; Cancel out (X-Y) term (6) 2Y=Y ; Substitute X for Y, by equation 1 (7) 2=1 ; Divide both sides by Y — "Omni", proof that 2 equals 1

content: 1.79 x 10^12 furlongs per fortnight -- it's not just a good idea, it's the law!
content_zh: 1.79 × 10^12 弗隆每两周 —— 这可不只是个好点子，这是物理定律！
content_en: 1.79 x 10^12 furlongs per fortnight -- it's not just a good idea, it's the law!

content: 10.0 times 0.1 is hardly ever 1.0.
content_zh: 10.0 乘以 0.1 几乎从来不等于 1.0。
content_en: 10.0 times 0.1 is hardly ever 1.0.

content: "355/113 -- Not the famous irrational number PI, but an incredible simulation!"
content_zh: "355/113 —— 虽然不是那个著名的无理数圆周率，但绝对是究极拟合！"
content_en: "355/113 -- Not the famous irrational number PI, but an incredible simulation!"

content: 7,140 pounds on the Sun 97 pounds on Mercury or Mars 255 pounds on Earth 232 pounds on Venus or Uranus 43 pounds on the Moon 648 pounds on Jupiter 275 pounds on Saturn 303 pounds on Neptune 13 pounds on Pluto — How much Elvis Presley would weigh at various places in the solar system.
content_zh: 在太阳上 7,140 磅，在水星或火星上 97 磅，在地球上 255 磅，在金星或天王星上 232 磅，在月球上 43 磅，在木星上 648 磅，在土星上 275 磅，在海王星上 303 磅，在冥王星上 13 磅 —— 盘点猫王在太阳系各星球上的体重。
content_en: 7,140 pounds on the Sun 97 pounds on Mercury or Mars 255 pounds on Earth 232 pounds on Venus or Uranus 43 pounds on the Moon 648 pounds on Jupiter 275 pounds on Saturn 303 pounds on Neptune 13 pounds on Pluto — How much Elvis Presley would weigh at various places in the solar system.

content: A conclusion is simply the place where someone got tired of thinking.
content_zh: 所谓结论，不过是某人懒得继续想下去的暂存断点。
content_en: A conclusion is simply the place where someone got tired of thinking.

content: A conference is a gathering of important people who singly can do nothing but together can decide that nothing can be done. — Fred Allen
content_zh: 所谓学术会议，就是把一群单拎出来毫无作为的大佬聚在一起，共同通过“什么也别干”的最高决议。——弗雷德·艾伦
content_en: A conference is a gathering of important people who singly can do nothing but together can decide that nothing can be done. — Fred Allen

content: A fail-safe circuit will destroy others. — Klipstein
content_zh: 防呆不防傻的电路，会自动炸毁周围所有正常的电路。——克利普斯坦
content_en: A fail-safe circuit will destroy others. — Klipstein

content: A failure will not appear until a unit has passed final inspection.
content_zh: 故障永远不会迟到，它只会挑在电路板通过终审、完美通电的瞬间闪亮登场。
content_en: A failure will not appear until a unit has passed final inspection.

content: "A fractal is by definition a set for which the Hausdorff Besicovitch dimension strictly exceeds the topological dimension." — Mandelbrot, "The Fractal Geometry of Nature"
content_zh: “分形，按定义来说，就是一个豪斯多夫-贝西柯维奇维数严格大于其拓扑维数的集合。”——芒德勃罗《大自然的几何学》
content_en: "A fractal is by definition a set for which the Hausdorff Besicovitch dimension strictly exceeds the topological dimension." — Mandelbrot, "The Fractal Geometry of Nature"

content: "A horrible little boy came up to me and said, `You know in your book The Martian Chronicles?' I said, `Yes?' He said, `You know where you talk about Deimos rising in the East?' I said, `Yes?' He said `No.' — So I hit him." — attributed to Ray Bradbury
content_zh: “一个熊孩子跑来对我说：‘你知道你写的《火星纪事》吗？’我说：‘知道啊？’他说：‘就你写火星卫星火卫二从东边升起那段？’我说：‘对啊？’他说：‘不对哦。’——然后我就给他来了一拳。”——据传为雷·布雷德伯里的轶事
content_en: "A horrible little boy came up to me and said, `You know in your book The Martian Chronicles?' I said, `Yes?' He said, `You know where you talk about Deimos rising in the East?' I said, `Yes?' He said `No.' — So I hit him." — attributed to Ray Bradbury

content: A mathematician is a device for turning coffee into theorems. — P. Erdos
content_zh: 数学家其实就是一个把咖啡转化为定理的转换器。——保罗·埃尔德什
content_en: A mathematician is a device for turning coffee into theorems. — P. Erdos

content: A method of solution is perfect if we can forsee from the start, and even prove, that following that method we shall attain our aim. — Leibniz
content_zh: 完美的解题方法，是我们从一开始就能预见——甚至在逻辑上证明——只要顺着这条路走下去，绝对能直达终点。——莱布尼茨
content_en: A method of solution is perfect if we can forsee from the start, and even prove, that following that method we shall attain our aim. — Leibniz

content: A pain in the ass of major dimensions. — C. A. Desoer, on the solution of non-linear circuits
content_zh: 这简直是个让人头大到爆、规模宏大的底层大坑。——C.A.德索尔（评价非线性电路求解）
content_en: A pain in the ass of major dimensions. — C. A. Desoer, on the solution of non-linear circuits

content: A physicist is an atom's way of knowing about atoms. — George Wald
content_zh: 物理学家，不过是原子为了认识原子而衍生出的自我反思机制罢了。——乔治·沃尔德
content_en: A physicist is an atom's way of knowing about atoms. — George Wald

content: A scientific truth does not triumph by convincing its opponents and making them see the light, but rather because its opponents eventually die and a new generation grows up that is familiar with it. — Max Planck
content_zh: 科学真理的胜利从来不是靠说服反对者让他们幡然醒悟，而是靠反对者们终于老去、死掉，而习惯了新真理的新一代年轻人长大了。——马克斯·普朗克
content_en: A scientific truth does not triumph by convincing its opponents and making them see the light, but rather because its opponents eventually die and a new generation grows up that is familiar with it. — Max Planck

content: A sine curve goes off to infinity, or at least the end of the blackboard. — Prof. Steiner
content_zh: 正弦曲线会一直延伸到无穷远处，或者至少延伸到黑板的边缘。——施泰纳教授
content_en: A sine curve goes off to infinity, or at least the end of the blackboard. — Prof. Steiner

content: A social scientist, studying the culture and traditions of a small North African tribe, found a woman still practicing the ancient art of matchmaking. Locally, she was known as the Moor, the marrier.
content_zh: 有个社会学家去北非一个小部落研究当地文化和传统，发现当地还有位大妈在操办古老的媒妁之言。在当地，她被称为“摩尔人，那个红娘”（注：Moor the marrier 谐音梗，神似 Moore's Law 摩尔定律）。
content_en: A social scientist, studying the culture and traditions of a small North African tribe, found a woman still practicing the ancient art of matchmaking. Locally, she was known as the Moor, the marrier.

content: A statistician, who refused to fly after reading of the alarmingly high probability that there will be a bomb on any given plane, realized that the probability of there being two bombs on any given flight is very low. Now, whenever he flies, he carries a bomb with him.
content_zh: 有个统计学家看了看飞机上出现炸弹的概率高得吓人，死活不肯坐飞机。后来他突然开窍：一架航班上同时出现两颗炸弹的概率低得令人发指！于是，他现在每次坐飞机都会随身带一颗炸弹。
content_en: A statistician, who refused to fly after reading of the alarmingly high probability that there will be a bomb on any given plane, realized that the probability of there being two bombs on any given flight is very low. Now, whenever he flies, he carries a bomb with him.

content: A transistor protected by a fast-acting fuse will protect the fuse by blowing first.
content_zh: 装了快熔保险丝的晶体管，为了保护保险丝，会义无反顾地先烧毁自己。
content_en: A transistor protected by a fast-acting fuse will protect the fuse by blowing first.

content: A triangle which has an angle of 135 degrees is called an obscene triangle.
content_zh: 有个角达到135度的三角形，被称为“大钝角三角形”（注：Obscene 谐音 Obtuse，直译或双关为“色情/不雅角”三角形）。
content_en: A triangle which has an angle of 135 degrees is called an obscene triangle.

content: According to convention there is a sweet and a bitter, a hot and a cold, and according to convention, there is an order. In truth, there are atoms and a void. — Democritus, 400 B.C.
content_zh: 依世俗之见有甜有苦、有热有冷，依世俗之见有秩序；而真实的宇宙，只有原子与虚空。—— 德谟克利特，公元前400年
content_en: According to convention there is a sweet and a bitter, a hot and a cold, and according to convention, there is an order. In truth, there are atoms and a void. — Democritus, 400 B.C.

content: According to the latest official figures, 43% of all statistics are totally worthless.
content_zh: 根据最新官方数据，43% 的统计数据纯属扯淡。
content_en: According to the latest official figures, 43% of all statistics are totally worthless.

content: ACHTUNG!!! Das machine is nicht fur gefingerpoken und mittengrabben. Ist easy schnappen der springenwerk, blowenfusen und corkenpoppen mit spitzensparken. Ist nicht fur gewerken by das dummkopfen. Das rubbernecken sightseeren keepen hands in das pockets. Relaxen und vatch das blinkenlights!!!
content_zh: 警告！！！本机绝非供人瞎手乱摸、盲目乱抓之物。里面那弹簧组件极易崩断、保险丝易炸、软木塞乱飞并伴随尖锐电火花。本机器绝不是给笨蛋们用来瞎折腾的。那些东张西望的吃瓜群众，把爪子老老实实揣口袋里。放松点，安心盯着那闪烁的小灯泡看就完事了！！！
content_en: ACHTUNG!!! Das machine is nicht fur gefingerpoken und mittengrabben. Ist easy schnappen der springenwerk, blowenfusen und corkenpoppen mit spitzensparken. Ist nicht fur gewerken by das dummkopfen. Das rubbernecken sightseeren keepen hands in das pockets. Relaxen und vatch das blinkenlights!!!

content: After a number of decimal places, nobody gives a damn.
content_zh: 小数点后过了那几位，谁特么在乎啊。
content_en: After a number of decimal places, nobody gives a damn.

content: After an instrument has been assembled, extra components will be found on the bench.
content_zh: 仪器组装完毕之日，便是实验台上多出不明零件之时。
content_en: After an instrument has been assembled, extra components will be found on the bench.

content: After the last of 16 mounting screws has been removed from an access cover, it will be discovered that the wrong access cover has been removed.
content_zh: 当你把检修口上的16颗固定螺丝全部卸完后，你会发现：拆错检修口了。
content_en: After the last of 16 mounting screws has been removed from an access cover, it will be discovered that the wrong access cover has been removed.

content: After years of research, scientists recently reported that there is, indeed, arroz in Spanish Harlem.
content_zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，科学家们最近终于郑重宣布：西班牙哈林区里确实有米饭（arroz）。
content_en: After years of research, scientists recently reported that there is, indeed, arroz in Spanish Harlem.

content: Against his wishes, a math teacher's classroom was remodeled. Ever since, he's been talking about the good old dais. His students planted a small orchard in his honor; the trees all have square roots.
content_zh: 一位数学老师的教室在违背他意愿的情况下进行了重新装修，从那以后他就一直在怀念那些“美好的旧日子（平方根/dais）”。他的学生为了向他致敬，在校园里种了一小片果树林；所有的树都有平方根（square roots/方根）。
content_en: Against his wishes, a math teacher's classroom was remodeled. Ever since, he's been talking about the good old dais. His students planted a small orchard in his honor; the trees all have square roots.

content: Air is water with holes in it.
content_zh: 空气就是带孔的水。
content_en: Air is water with holes in it.

content: Air pollution is really making us pay through the nose.
content_zh: 空气污染真是让我们付出了“肺”常惨重的鼻炎代价。
content_en: Air pollution is really making us pay through the nose.

content: Alexander Graham Bell is alive and well in New York, and still waiting for a dial tone.
content_zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔在纽约活得好好的，只是还在等拨号音。
content_en: Alexander Graham Bell is alive and well in New York, and still waiting for a dial tone.

content: Algebraic symbols are used when you do not know what you are talking about. — Philippe Schnoebelen
content_zh: 代数符号是在你根本不知道自己在胡扯什么的时候派上用场的。——菲利普·施内贝兰
content_en: Algebraic symbols are used when you do not know what you are talking about. — Philippe Schnoebelen

content: All Finagle Laws may be bypassed by learning the simple art of doing without thinking.
content_zh: 掌握了“不经大脑”这门绝技，就能直接绕过所有芬格尔定律。
content_en: All Finagle Laws may be bypassed by learning the simple art of doing without thinking.

content: All great discoveries are made by mistake. — Young
content_zh: 所有伟大的发现，本质上都是美丽的失误。——杨
content_en: All great discoveries are made by mistake. — Young

content: All great ideas are controversial, or have been at one time.
content_zh: 所有伟大的点子在刚提出来时都离经叛道，要么曾经如此（比如哥白尼说地球转的时候）。
content_en: All great ideas are controversial, or have been at one time.

content: All laws are simulations of reality. — John C. Lilly
content_zh: 万物皆拟合，世事尽沙盒。——约翰·C·莉莉
content_en: All laws are simulations of reality. — John C. Lilly

content: All life evolves by the differential survival of replicating entities. — Dawkins
content_zh: 生命演化的本质，不过是复制子在代码层面的优胜劣汰。——道金斯
content_en: All life evolves by the differential survival of replicating entities. — Dawkins

content: All power corrupts, but we need electricity.
content_zh: 权力使人腐化，但烧CPU需要电力。
content_en: All power corrupts, but we need electricity.

content: All science is either physics or stamp collecting. — Ernest Rutherford
content_zh: 世上科学分为两种：物理学和集邮（比如其他学科）。——欧内斯特·卢瑟福
content_en: All science is either physics or stamp collecting. — Ernest Rutherford

content: All seems condemned in the long run to approximate a state akin to Gaussian noise. — James Martin
content_zh: 从长远来看，万物的终极宿命都是向高斯白噪声无限收敛。——詹姆斯·马丁
content_en: All seems condemned in the long run to approximate a state akin to Gaussian noise. — James Martin

content: All syllogisms have three parts, therefore this is not a syllogism.
content_zh: 所有的三段论都有三部分，所以这不是一个三段论。
content_en: All syllogisms have three parts, therefore this is not a syllogism.

content: All the evidence concerning the universe has not yet been collected, so there's still hope.
content_zh: 有关宇宙的所有证据都还没收集完，所以说，还是有希望的。
content_en: All the evidence concerning the universe has not yet been collected, so there's still hope.

content: All theoretical chemistry is really physics; and all theoretical chemists know it. — Richard P. Feynman
content_zh: 所有理论化学其实都是物理；而所有的理论化学家也都心知肚明。——理查德·费曼
content_en: All theoretical chemistry is really physics; and all theoretical chemists know it. — Richard P. Feynman

content: Although the moon is smaller than the earth, it is farther away.
content_zh: 尽管月亮比地球小，但它离得远啊。
content_en: Although the moon is smaller than the earth, it is farther away.

content: Always draw your curves, then plot your reading.
content_zh: 先把曲线画好，再把实验数据描上去。
content_en: Always draw your curves, then plot your reading.

content: Always leave room to add an explanation if it doesn't work out.
content_zh: 凡事总要留出空位，万一跑不通好加上一行注释。
content_en: Always leave room to add an explanation if it doesn't work out.

content: Always think of something new; this helps you forget your last rotten idea. — Seth Frankel
content_zh: 永远去想点新鲜的骚主意；这样能帮你彻底忘掉上一个烂到家的 Bug。——赛斯·弗兰克尔
content_en: Always think of something new; this helps you forget your last rotten idea. — Seth Frankel

content: Always try to do things in chronological order; it's less confusing that way.
content_zh: 做事情一定要按时间戳顺序来；这样才不会把线程给整崩溃。
content_en: Always try to do things in chronological order; it's less confusing that way.

content: An age is called Dark not because the light fails to shine, but because people refuse to see it. — James Michener, "Space"
content_zh: 一个时代被称为黑暗，并不是因为光芒熄灭了，而是因为大家集体装瞎，拒绝看见真理。——詹姆斯·米切纳，《太空》
content_en: An age is called Dark not because the light fails to shine, but because people refuse to see it. — James Michener, "Space"

content: An anthropologist at Tulane has just come back from a field trip to New Guinea with reports of a tribe so primitive that they have Tide but not new Tide with lemon-fresh Borax. — David Letterman
content_zh: 杜兰大学的一位人类学家刚从新几内亚考察回来，带回了一个令人震惊的原始部落报告：那里的人原始到竟然只用普通汰渍，却还不知道带柠檬清新硼砂成分的新一代汰渍。——大卫·莱特曼
content_en: An anthropologist at Tulane has just come back from a field trip to New Guinea with reports of a tribe so primitive that they have Tide but not new Tide with lemon-fresh Borax. — David Letterman

content: An authority is a person who can tell you more about something than you really care to know.
content_zh: 所谓大牛专家，就是那种能向你滔滔不绝科普一大堆、而你压根连半个字都不想关心的狠角色。
content_en: An authority is a person who can tell you more about something than you really care to know.

content: An economist is a man who would marry Farrah Fawcett-Majors for her money.
content_zh: 经济学家这种生物，为了钱绝对会把法瑞娜·福赛特-迈杰斯给娶了。
content_en: An economist is a man who would marry Farrah Fawcett-Majors for her money.

content: An egghead is one who stands firmly on both feet, in mid-air, on both sides of an issue. — Homer Ferguson
content_zh: 所谓书呆子，就是那种能同时脚踩两只船、悬在半空中、把所有立场两头占尽的人。——霍默·弗格森
content_en: An egghead is one who stands firmly on both feet, in mid-air, on both sides of an issue. — Homer Ferguson

content: And this is a table ma'am. What in essence it consists of is a horizontal rectilinear plane surface maintained by four vertical columnar supports, which we call legs. The tables in this laboratory, ma'am, are as advanced in design as one will find anywhere in the world. — Michael Frayn, "The Tin Men"
content_zh: 夫人，这就是一张桌子。它本质上是由一个水平的直线矩形平面组成的，并靠四个垂直的柱状支撑物——我们称之为桌腿——来维持。夫人，本实验室的这些桌子，在设计上绝对是全球最先进的水平。——迈克尔·弗雷恩《锡人》
content_en: And this is a table ma'am. What in essence it consists of is a horizontal rectilinear plane surface maintained by four vertical columnar supports, which we call legs. The tables in this laboratory, ma'am, are as advanced in design as one will find anywhere in the world. — Michael Frayn, "The Tin Men"

content: Any circuit design must contain at least one part which is obsolete, two parts which are unobtainable, and three parts which are still under development.
content_zh: 任何电路设计都必须包含：至少一个已经停产的元器件、两个买也买不到的元器件，以及三个还在PPT研发阶段的元器件。
content_en: Any circuit design must contain at least one part which is obsolete, two parts which are unobtainable, and three parts which are still under development.

content: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from a rigged demo.
content_zh: 任何足够先进的技术，看起来都跟提前写好剧本的PPT演示或虚假代打没两样。
content_en: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from a rigged demo.

content: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic. — Arthur C. Clarke
content_zh: 任何足够先进的技术，初看都与魔法无异。——阿瑟·克拉克
content_en: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic. — Arthur C. Clarke

content: Anyone who cannot cope with mathematics is not fully human. At best he is a tolerable subhuman who has learned to wear shoes, bathe and not make messes in the house. — Lazarus Long, "Time Enough for Love"
content_zh: 任何无法应付数学的人都不算真正意义上完整的人。充其量不过是个勉强学会穿鞋、洗澡且不在屋里随地大小便的次人类。——拉撒路·朗《爱e足资的时光》
content_en: Anyone who cannot cope with mathematics is not fully human. At best he is a tolerable subhuman who has learned to wear shoes, bathe and not make messes in the house. — Lazarus Long, "Time Enough for Love"

content: Anyone who imagines that all fruits ripen at the same time as the strawberries, knows nothing about grapes. — Philippus Paracelsus
content_zh: 谁要是觉得所有水果都跟草莓一样同时熟，那他绝对连葡萄长啥样都没搞懂。 —— 菲利普斯·帕拉塞尔苏斯
content_en: Anyone who imagines that all fruits ripen at the same time as the strawberries, knows nothing about grapes. — Philippus Paracelsus

content: "Anything created must necessarily be inferior to the essence of the creator." — Claude Shouse "Einstein's mother must have been one heck of a physicist." — Joseph C. Wang
content_zh: “任何被创造之物，必然逊色于创造者的本质。” —— 克劳德·肖斯 “那爱因斯坦的妈得是个多么硬核的物理学家啊。” —— 约瑟夫·C·王
content_en: "Anything created must necessarily be inferior to the essence of the creator." — Claude Shouse "Einstein's mother must have been one heck of a physicist." — Joseph C. Wang

content: Anything cut to length will be too short.
content_zh: 任何按尺寸裁切好的东西，装上去都会发现短了一截。
content_en: Anything cut to length will be too short.

content: Arithmetic is being able to count up to twenty without taking off your shoes. — Mickey Mouse
content_zh: 算术就是不用脱鞋也能数到二十。 —— 米老鼠
content_en: Arithmetic is being able to count up to twenty without taking off your shoes. — Mickey Mouse

content: Artificial intelligence has the same relation to intelligence as artificial flowers have to flowers. — David Parnas
content_zh: 人工智能之于真正的智能，正如塑料花之于真正的鲜花。 —— 大卫·帕纳斯
content_en: Artificial intelligence has the same relation to intelligence as artificial flowers have to flowers. — David Parnas

content: "As an adolescent I aspired to lasting fame, I craved factual certainty, and I thirsted for a meaningful vision of human life -- so I became a scientist. This is like becoming an archbishop so you can meet girls." — Matt Cartmill
content_zh: “少年时我渴望名垂青史、渴求绝对的真理，并对人类生命的意义充满狂热——于是我成了一名科学家。这就好比为了泡妞而跑去当大主教。” —— 马特·卡特米尔
content_en: "As an adolescent I aspired to lasting fame, I craved factual certainty, and I thirsted for a meaningful vision of human life -- so I became a scientist. This is like becoming an archbishop so you can meet girls." — Matt Cartmill

content: As far as the laws of mathematics refer to reality, they are not certain, and as far as they are certain, they do not refer to reality. — Albert Einstein
content_zh: 数学定律凡是谈及现实的，都不确定；凡是确定的，都不谈及现实。——阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦
content_en: As far as the laws of mathematics refer to reality, they are not certain, and as far as they are certain, they do not refer to reality. — Albert Einstein

content: As you will see, I told them, in no uncertain terms, to see Figure one. — Dave "First Strike" Pare
content_zh: 正如你所见，我斩钉截铁地告诉他们：请看图一。——戴夫·“先发制人”·帕尔
content_en: As you will see, I told them, in no uncertain terms, to see Figure one. — Dave "First Strike" Pare

content: Ask five economists and you'll get five different explanations (six if one went to Harvard). — Edgar R. Fiedler
content_zh: 问五个经济学家，你会得到五种不同的解释（如果其中一个是哈佛毕业的，那就是六种）。——埃德加·R·菲德勒
content_en: Ask five economists and you'll get five different explanations (six if one went to Harvard). — Edgar R. Fiedler

content: At any given moment, an arrow must be either where it is or where it is not. But obviously it cannot be where it is not. And if it is where it is, that is equivalent to saying that it is at rest. — Zeno's paradox of the moving (still?) arrow
content_zh: 在任何给定的瞬间，一支飞箭必定要么在它所在的地方，要么不在。但它显然不可能在它不在的地方；而如果它在它所在的地方，这就等同于说它是静止的。——芝诺关于运动（静止？）飞箭的悖论
content_en: At any given moment, an arrow must be either where it is or where it is not. But obviously it cannot be where it is not. And if it is where it is, that is equivalent to saying that it is at rest. — Zeno's paradox of the moving (still?) arrow

content: Base 8 is just like base 10, if you are missing two fingers. — Tom Lehrer
content_zh: 八进制和十进制其实没两样——只要你少了两根手指头。——汤姆·勒雷
content_en: Base 8 is just like base 10, if you are missing two fingers. — Tom Lehrer

content: Before Xerox, five carbons were the maximum extension of anybody's ego.
content_zh: 在施乐（Xerox）出现之前，复写五份就是一个人自我膨胀的极限了。
content_en: Before Xerox, five carbons were the maximum extension of anybody's ego.

content: Between infinite and short there is a big difference. — G. H. Gonnet
content_zh: 在“无穷”与“稍等”之间，横亘着一道巨大的鸿沟。——G·H·戈内特
content_en: Between infinite and short there is a big difference. — G. H. Gonnet

content: Biology is the only science in which multiplication means the same thing as division.
content_zh: 生物学是唯一一门乘法和除法含义完全相同的学科。
content_en: Biology is the only science in which multiplication means the same thing as division.

content: But it does move! — Galileo Galilei
content_zh: 可它分明在动啊！——伽利略
content_en: But it does move! — Galileo Galilei

content: But you who live on dreams, you are better pleased with the sophistical reasoning and frauds of talkers about great and uncertain matters than those who speak of certain and natural matters, not of such lofty nature. — Leonardo Da Vinci, "The Codex on the Flight of Birds"
content_zh: 而你们这些靠做梦度日的人，比起那些谈论确凿自然之理、虽不那么高大上的人，更喜欢听信夸夸其谈者的诡辩与骗局，去探讨那些伟大却缥缈的事物。——列奥纳多·达·芬奇，《论鸟类的飞行》
content_en: But you who live on dreams, you are better pleased with the sophistical reasoning and frauds of talkers about great and uncertain matters than those who speak of certain and natural matters, not of such lofty nature. — Leonardo Da Vinci, "The Codex on the Flight of Birds"

content: Celestial navigation is based on the premise that the Earth is the center of the universe. The premise is wrong, but the navigation works. An incorrect model can be a useful tool. — Kelvin Throop III
content_zh: 天文导航基于一个前提：地球是宇宙的中心。前提虽然错了，但导航确实好用。错误的模型，照样能成为神兵利器。——凯尔文·特鲁普三世
content_en: Celestial navigation is based on the premise that the Earth is the center of the universe. The premise is wrong, but the navigation works. An incorrect model can be a useful tool. — Kelvin Throop III

content: Chemist who falls in acid is absorbed in work.
content_zh: 掉进酸里的化学家，全身心沉浸在工作中。
content_en: Chemist who falls in acid is absorbed in work.

content: Chemist who falls in acid will be tripping for weeks.
content_zh: 掉进酸里的化学家，能嗨（high）上好几周。
content_en: Chemist who falls in acid will be tripping for weeks.

content: Chemistry is applied theology. — Augustus Stanley Owsley III
content_zh: 化学就是应用神学。——奥古斯都·斯坦利·欧斯利三世
content_en: Chemistry is applied theology. — Augustus Stanley Owsley III

content: Chemistry professors never die, they just fail to react.
content_zh: 化学教授从不消亡，他们只是不再反应。
content_en: Chemistry professors never die, they just fail to react.

content: "Consider a spherical bear, in simple harmonic motion..." — Professor in the UCB physics department
content_zh: “假设有一只做简谐运动的球形熊……”——加州大学伯克利分校物理系教授
content_en: "Consider a spherical bear, in simple harmonic motion..." — Professor in the UCB physics department

content: "Contrariwise," continued Tweedledee, "if it was so, it might be, and if it were so, it would be; but as it isn't, it ain't. That's logic!" — Lewis Carroll, "Through the Looking Glass"
content_zh: “反过来说，”特维德利接着说，“要是它是真的，它可能发生；要是它是真的过头了，它就一定会发生；但既然它不是真的，那它就没发生。这就是逻辑！”——刘易斯·卡罗尔《爱丽丝镜中奇遇记》
