content_en: "Contrariwise," continued Tweedledee, "if it was so, it might be, and if it were so, it would be; but as it isn't, it ain't. That's logic!" — Lewis Carroll, "Through the Looking Glass"

content: "Deep" is a word like "theory" or "semantic" -- it implies all sorts of marvelous things. It's one thing to be able to say "I've got a theory", quite another to say "I've got a semantic theory", but, ah, those who can claim "I've got a deep semantic theory", they are truly blessed. — Randy Davis
content_zh: “深奥”是个像“理论”或“语义”一样的词——它暗示着各种奇妙的宏大叙事。能说一句“我有个理论”是一回事，能说“我有个语义理论”是另一回事；而啊，那些能自豪宣称“我有个深奥的语义理论”的人，才是真正天选的智者。——兰迪·戴维斯
content_en: "Deep" is a word like "theory" or "semantic" -- it implies all sorts of marvelous things. It's one thing to be able to say "I've got a theory", quite another to say "I've got a semantic theory", but, ah, those who can claim "I've got a deep semantic theory", they are truly blessed. — Randy Davis

content: Did you hear that there's a group of South American Indians that worship the number zero? Is nothing sacred?
content_zh: 听说南美洲有个印第安部落把数字零当神拜。难道这世上连“虚无”都不神圣了吗？
content_en: Did you hear that there's a group of South American Indians that worship the number zero? Is nothing sacred?

content: Did you hear that two rabbits escaped from the zoo and so far they have only recaptured 116 of them?
content_zh: 听说动物园里跑了两只兔子，结果到现在才抓回116只？
content_en: Did you hear that two rabbits escaped from the zoo and so far they have only recaptured 116 of them?

content: Did you know that if you took all the economists in the world and lined them up end to end, they'd still point in the wrong direction?
content_zh: 你知道吗？要是把全世界的经济学家首尾相连排成一整排，他们依然会指向错误的方向。
content_en: Did you know that if you took all the economists in the world and lined them up end to end, they'd still point in the wrong direction?

content: Dimensions will always be expressed in the least usable term, convertible only through the use of weird and unnatural conversion factors. Velocity, for example, will be expressed in furlongs per fortnight.
content_zh: 物理量的单位永远是最难用的那种，且只能通过诡异且反人类的换算系数来转换。比如，速度的单位会被表示为“弗隆每两周”。
content_en: Dimensions will always be expressed in the least usable term, convertible only through the use of weird and unnatural conversion factors. Velocity, for example, will be expressed in furlongs per fortnight.

content: Dinosaurs aren't extinct. They've just learned to hide in the trees.
content_zh: 恐龙并没有灭绝，它们只是学会了藏在树上。
content_en: Dinosaurs aren't extinct. They've just learned to hide in the trees.

content: Do molecular biologists wear designer genes?
content_zh: 分子生物学家穿的都是“高定基因”吗？
content_en: Do molecular biologists wear designer genes?

content: Duct tape is like the force. It has a light side, and a dark side, and it holds the universe together ... — Carl Zwanzig
content_zh: 力学胶带就像原力：它有光明面，有黑暗面，而且它把整个宇宙粘在了一起……——卡尔·兹万齐格
content_en: Duct tape is like the force. It has a light side, and a dark side, and it holds the universe together ... — Carl Zwanzig

content: Economics is extremely useful as a form of employment for economists. — John Kenneth Galbraith
content_zh: 经济学极其有用，主要在于它为经济学家解决了就业问题。——约翰·肯尼斯·加尔布雷思
content_en: Economics is extremely useful as a form of employment for economists. — John Kenneth Galbraith

content: Economists can certainly disappoint you. One said that the economy would turn up by the last quarter. Well, I'm down to mine and it hasn't. — Robert Orben
content_zh: 经济学家确实能让你大跌眼镜。有个家伙说经济会在最后一个季度触底反弹，结果倒好，我现在穷得只剩最后一个硬币了，它还没反弹。——罗伯特·奥本
content_en: Economists can certainly disappoint you. One said that the economy would turn up by the last quarter. Well, I'm down to mine and it hasn't. — Robert Orben

content: Economists state their GNP growth projections to the nearest tenth of a percentage point to prove they have a sense of humor. — Edgar R. Fiedler
content_zh: 经济学家把GNP增长预测精确到百分之一的小数点后一位，就是为了证明他们其实挺有幽默感的。——埃德加·R·菲德勒
content_en: Economists state their GNP growth projections to the nearest tenth of a percentage point to prove they have a sense of humor. — Edgar R. Fiedler

content: Elegance and truth are inversely related. — Becker's Razor
content_zh: 优雅与真相成反比。——贝克尔剃刀定律
content_en: Elegance and truth are inversely related. — Becker's Razor

content: Elliptic paraboloids for sale.
content_zh: 椭圆抛物面大甩卖啦。
content_en: Elliptic paraboloids for sale.

content: Entropy requires no maintenance. — Markoff Chaney
content_zh: 熵增不需要任何维护成本。——马克·查尼
content_en: Entropy requires no maintenance. — Markoff Chaney

content: Enzymes are things invented by biologists that explain things which otherwise require harder thinking. — Jerome Lettvin
content_zh: 酶是生物学家发明出来的一种东西，用来解释那些原本需要动脑子思考的问题。——杰罗姆·莱特文
content_en: Enzymes are things invented by biologists that explain things which otherwise require harder thinking. — Jerome Lettvin

content: Every little picofarad has a nanohenry all its own. — Don Vonada
content_zh: 每一个微小的皮法，都有属于它自己的纳米亨利。——唐·沃纳达
content_en: Every little picofarad has a nanohenry all its own. — Don Vonada

content: Every nonzero finite dimensional inner product space has an orthonormal basis. It makes sense, when you don't think about it.
content_zh: 每个非零有限维内积空间都有一组标准正交基。只要不去细想，它确实挺合理的。
content_en: Every nonzero finite dimensional inner product space has an orthonormal basis. It makes sense, when you don't think about it.

content: Every paper published in a respectable journal should have a preface by the author stating why he is publishing the article, and what value he sees in it. I have no hope that this practice will ever be adopted. — Morris Kline
content_zh: 每一篇在正规期刊上发表的论文都应该附有一篇作者的序言，说明他为什么要发表这篇文章以及他认为这其中有什么价值。我敢说这规矩永远也普及不了。——莫里斯·克莱因
content_en: Every paper published in a respectable journal should have a preface by the author stating why he is publishing the article, and what value he sees in it. I have no hope that this practice will ever be adopted. — Morris Kline

content: Everything should be made as simple as possible, but not simpler. — Albert Einstein
content_zh: 凡事都应力求简明，但不能过于简单。——阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦
content_en: Everything should be made as simple as possible, but not simpler. — Albert Einstein

content: Everything that can be invented has been invented. — Charles Duell, Director of U.S. Patent Office, 1899
content_zh: 凡是能被发明的，都已经发明出来了。——查尔斯·杜尔，美国专利局局长，1899年（旗帜鲜明地打脸未来）
content_en: Everything that can be invented has been invented. — Charles Duell, Director of U.S. Patent Office, 1899

content: Experience varies directly with equipment ruined.
content_zh: 经验值与被你搞砸的实验设备数量成正比。
content_en: Experience varies directly with equipment ruined.

content: Experiments must be reproducible; they should all fail in the same way.
content_zh: 实验必须是可重复的：它们至少得以完全相同的方式集体翻车。
content_en: Experiments must be reproducible; they should all fail in the same way.

content: Factorials were someone's attempt to make math LOOK exciting.
content_zh: 阶乘符号（!）不过是某些人试图让数学看起来很激进而已。
content_en: Factorials were someone's attempt to make math LOOK exciting.

content: Facts are stubborn, but statistics are more pliable.
content_zh: 事实固然顽固，但统计数据明显更懂“听话”。
content_en: Facts are stubborn, but statistics are more pliable.

content: Federal grants are offered for... research into the recreation potential of interplanetary space travel for the culturally disadvantaged.
content_zh: 联邦科研经费现正资助一项宏大课题：研究面向文化弱势群体的星际旅行休闲娱乐潜力。
content_en: Federal grants are offered for... research into the recreation potential of interplanetary space travel for the culturally disadvantaged.

content: Five is a sufficiently close approximation to infinity. — Robert Firth "One, two, five." — Monty Python and the Holy Grail
content_zh: “五”已经足够无限接近无穷大了。——罗伯特·弗思（“一、二、五。”——《巨蟒与圣杯》）
content_en: Five is a sufficiently close approximation to infinity. — Robert Firth "One, two, five." — Monty Python and the Holy Grail

content: For every complex problem, there is a solution that is simple, neat, and wrong. — H. L. Mencken
content_zh: 对于每一个复杂的问题，都有一个极其简单、干净利落且完全错误的解法。——H·L·孟肯
content_en: For every complex problem, there is a solution that is simple, neat, and wrong. — H. L. Mencken

content: For God's sake, stop researching for a while and begin to think!
content_zh: 看在上帝的份上，先别盲目跑实验刷数据了，停下来用大脑思考一下吧！
content_en: For God's sake, stop researching for a while and begin to think!

content: For large values of one, one equals two, for small values of two.
content_zh: 在“一”的取值足够大时，一等于二；或者在“二”的取值足够小时，也是如此。
content_en: For large values of one, one equals two, for small values of two.

content: FORTUNE'S FUN FACTS TO KNOW AND TELL: #44 Zebras are colored with dark stripes on a light background.
content_zh: 幸运博士冷知识：#44 斑马其实是在浅色底色上画了深色条纹。
content_en: FORTUNE'S FUN FACTS TO KNOW AND TELL: #44 Zebras are colored with dark stripes on a light background.

content: Fundamentally, there may be no basis for anything.
content_zh: 从根本底层逻辑来看，这世上可能压根就没有任何基础可言。
content_en: Fundamentally, there may be no basis for anything.

content: Genetics explains why you look like your father, and if you don't, why you should.
content_zh: 基因解释了为什么你长得像你爸，而如果你长得不像，解释了为什么你该去做亲子鉴定。
content_en: Genetics explains why you look like your father, and if you don't, why you should.

content: (German philosopher) Georg Wilhelm Hegel, on his deathbed, complained, "Only one man ever understood me." He fell silent for a while and then added, "And he didn't understand me."
content_zh: 德国哲学家黑格尔在临终前抱怨道：“这世上只有一个懂我的人。”他沉默了一会儿，又补了一句：“但他其实也没懂我。”
content_en: (German philosopher) Georg Wilhelm Hegel, on his deathbed, complained, "Only one man ever understood me." He fell silent for a while and then added, "And he didn't understand me."

content: God doesn't play dice. — Albert Einstein
content_zh: 上帝不掷骰子。——阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦
content_en: God doesn't play dice. — Albert Einstein

content: God made the integers; all else is the work of Man. — Kronecker
content_zh: 上帝创造了整数，其余皆为人造。——克罗内克
content_en: God made the integers; all else is the work of Man. — Kronecker

content: God runs electromagnetics by wave theory on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, and the Devil runs them by quantum theory on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday. — William Bragg
content_zh: 上帝在周一、周三和周五用波动理论掌管电磁学，而魔鬼则在周二、周四和周六用量子理论来捣乱。——威廉·布拉格
content_en: God runs electromagnetics by wave theory on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, and the Devil runs them by quantum theory on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday. — William Bragg

content: Going the speed of light is bad for your age.
content_zh: 以光速旅行对你的生理年龄非常不利。
content_en: Going the speed of light is bad for your age.

content: Good morning. This is the telephone company. Due to repairs, we're giving you advance notice that your service will be cut off indefinitely at ten o'clock. That's two minutes from now.
content_zh: 早安，这里是电话公司。因线路检修，我们提前友情提示：您的宽带将在两分钟后（即十点整）永久断网。
content_en: Good morning. This is the telephone company. Due to repairs, we're giving you advance notice that your service will be cut off indefinitely at ten o'clock. That's two minutes from now.

content: Gosh that takes me back... or is it forward? That's the trouble with time travel, you never can tell." — Doctor Who, "Androids of Tara"
content_zh: 天哪，这把我的思绪拉回了过去……不对，是带到了未来？这就是时间旅行的痛点，你永远搞不清楚。
content_en: Gosh that takes me back... or is it forward? That's the trouble with time travel, you never can tell." — Doctor Who, "Androids of Tara"

content: Got Mole problems? Call Avogadro at 6.02 x 10^23.
content_zh: 莫尔（摩尔）烦恼缠身？请拨打阿伏伽德罗热线：6.02 × 10^23。
content_en: Got Mole problems? Call Avogadro at 6.02 x 10^23.

content: Gravity is a myth, the Earth sucks.
content_zh: 引力纯属虚构，是地球太会吸了。
content_en: Gravity is a myth, the Earth sucks.

content: I have hardly ever known a mathematician who was capable of reasoning. — Plato
content_zh: 我几乎从未见过哪个数学家具备逻辑推理能力。——柏拉图
content_en: I have hardly ever known a mathematician who was capable of reasoning. — Plato

content: I tell them to turn to the study of mathematics, for it is only there that they might escape the lusts of the flesh. — Thomas Mann, "The Magic Mountain"
content_zh: 我劝他们去钻研数学，因为唯有在那里，方能逃离皮肉之欲的纠缠。——托马斯·曼《魔山》
content_en: I tell them to turn to the study of mathematics, for it is only there that they might escape the lusts of the flesh. — Thomas Mann, "The Magic Mountain"

content: "I think it is true for all n. I was just playing it safe with n >= 3 because I couldn't remember the proof." — Baker, Pure Math 351a
content_zh: “我觉得这个结论对所有的 $n$ 都成立。我写 $n \ge 3$ 纯粹是因为我怂了，记不清证明过程了。” —— 贝克，《纯数学 351a》
content_en: "I think it is true for all n. I was just playing it safe with n >= 3 because I couldn't remember the proof." — Baker, Pure Math 351a

content: If A = B and B = C, then A = C, except where void or prohibited by law. — Roy Santoro
content_zh: 若 $A = B$ 且 $B = C$，则 $A = C$（法律禁止或无效的情形除外）。—— 罗伊·桑托罗
content_en: If A = B and B = C, then A = C, except where void or prohibited by law. — Roy Santoro

content: If God is perfect, why did He create discontinuous functions?
content_zh: 如果上帝是完美的，他当初为什么要创造间断函数？

  <item id="stem_6b8a4ef0e7">没有COBOL和Fortran的计算机，就像是没有番茄酱和黄芥末酱的巧克力蛋糕。
content_en: [A computer is] like an Old Testament god, with a lot of rules and no mercy. — Joseph Campbell

content: A computer lets you make more mistakes faster than any other invention, with the possible exceptions of handguns and Tequilla. — Mitch Ratcliffe
content_zh: A computer lets you make more mistakes faster than any other invention, with the possible exceptions of handguns and Tequilla. — Mitch Ratcliffe
content_en: A computer lets you make more mistakes faster than any other invention, with the possible exceptions of handguns and Tequilla. — Mitch Ratcliffe

content: A computer scientist is someone who fixes things that aren't broken.
content_zh: A computer scientist is someone who fixes things that aren't broken.
content_en: A computer scientist is someone who fixes things that aren't broken.

content: A computer without COBOL and Fortran is like a piece of chocolate cake without ketchup and mustard.
content_zh: A computer without COBOL and Fortran is like a piece of chocolate cake without ketchup and mustard.
content_en: A computer without COBOL and Fortran is like a piece of chocolate cake without ketchup and mustard.

content: A CONS is an object which cares. — Bernie Greenberg.
content_zh: 所谓的 CONS，就是一个有着老母亲般操心的对象。——伯尼·格林伯格 (Bernie Greenberg)
content_en: A CONS is an object which cares. — Bernie Greenberg.

content: A debugged program is one for which you have not yet found the conditions that make it fail. — Jerry Ogdin
content_zh: 一个没有Bug的程序，只是因为你还没触发让它崩溃的条件罢了。——杰里·奥格丁 (Jerry Ogdin)
content_en: A debugged program is one for which you have not yet found the conditions that make it fail. — Jerry Ogdin

content: A disciple of another sect once came to Drescher as he was eating his morning meal. "I would like to give you this personality test", said the outsider, "because I want you to be happy." Drescher took the paper that was offered him and put it into the toaster -- "I wish the toaster to be happy too".
content_zh: 某教派的门徒在德雷舍吃早饭时找上门来：“我想送你这份性格测试，因为我希望你能快乐。”德雷舍接过递过来的纸，顺手把它塞进了烤面包机里——“我也希望烤面包机能快乐。”
content_en: A disciple of another sect once came to Drescher as he was eating his morning meal. "I would like to give you this personality test", said the outsider, "because I want you to be happy." Drescher took the paper that was offered him and put it into the toaster -- "I wish the toaster to be happy too".

content: A formal parsing algorithm should not always be used. — D. Gries
content_zh: 形式化解析算法可不兴到处乱用啊。——D·格里斯 (D. Gries)
content_en: A formal parsing algorithm should not always be used. — D. Gries

content: A Fortran compiler is the hobgoblin of little minis.
content_zh: Fortran编译器就是那一小撮微型机的夜半小妖精。
content_en: A Fortran compiler is the hobgoblin of little minis.

content: A hacker does for love what others would not do for money.
content_zh: 黑客为了爱而做的事，别人拿钱都未必肯干。
content_en: A hacker does for love what others would not do for money.

content: A language that doesn't affect the way you think about programming is not worth knowing.
content_zh: 不曾重塑你编程思维的语言，不学也罢。
content_en: A language that doesn't affect the way you think about programming is not worth knowing.

content: A language that doesn't have everything is actually easier to program in than some that do. — Dennis M. Ritchie
content_zh: 什么都有的语言，其实不如什么都没有的语言好写。——丹尼斯·里奇
content_en: A language that doesn't have everything is actually easier to program in than some that do. — Dennis M. Ritchie

content: A large number of installed systems work by fiat. That is, they work by being declared to work. — Anatol Holt
content_zh: 很多上线的系统全靠御旨——也就是说，上面说它行，它就行。——阿纳托尔·霍尔特
content_en: A large number of installed systems work by fiat. That is, they work by being declared to work. — Anatol Holt

content: A LISP programmer knows the value of everything, but the cost of nothing. — Alan Perlis
content_zh: LISP 程序员知晓万物之价值，却对开销一无所知。——艾伦·佩利斯
content_en: A LISP programmer knows the value of everything, but the cost of nothing. — Alan Perlis

content: A list is only as strong as its weakest link. — Don Knuth
content_zh: 链表的强度取决于它最脆弱的那一个节点。——高德纳
content_en: A list is only as strong as its weakest link. — Don Knuth

content: A modem is a baudy house.
content_zh: 调制解调器（Modem）就是一个彻头彻尾的“波特”（Baud）风月场。
content_en: A modem is a baudy house.

content: A nasty looking dwarf throws a knife at you.
content_zh: 一个长相猥琐的矮人朝你扔来一把飞刀。
content_en: A nasty looking dwarf throws a knife at you.

content: A novice was trying to fix a broken lisp machine by turning the power off and on. Knight, seeing what the student was doing spoke sternly, "You cannot fix a machine by just power-cycling it with no understanding of what is going wrong." Knight turned the machine off and on. The machine worked.
content_zh: 一个菜鸟正试图通过反复开关机来修复一台死机的Lisp机器。奈特看到这名学生的举动，严厉地训斥道：“你不能在完全不懂故障原因的情况下，仅凭盲目重启来修好机器！”接着，奈特走过去关了机又开机。机器居然好了。
content_en: A novice was trying to fix a broken lisp machine by turning the power off and on. Knight, seeing what the student was doing spoke sternly, "You cannot fix a machine by just power-cycling it with no understanding of what is going wrong." Knight turned the machine off and on. The machine worked.

content: A person who is more than casually interested in computers should be well schooled in machine language, since it is a fundamental part of a computer. — Donald Knuth
content_zh: 任何一个对计算机抱有深入兴趣的人，都应当精通机器语言，因为它是计算机不可或缺的底层基石。——唐纳德·克努特
content_en: A person who is more than casually interested in computers should be well schooled in machine language, since it is a fundamental part of a computer. — Donald Knuth

content: A programming language is low level when its programs require attention to the irrelevant.
content_zh: 当一门编程语言的程序需要你把精力浪费在那些无关紧要的琐事上时，它就是一门低级语言。
content_en: A programming language is low level when its programs require attention to the irrelevant.

content: A recent study has found that concentrating on difficult off-screen objects, such as the faces of loved ones, causes eye strain in computer scientists. Researchers into the phenomenon cite the added concentration needed to "make sense" of such unnatural three dimensional objects.
content_zh: 一项最新研究表明，让计算机科学家集中精力去凝视屏幕之外的高难度物体（比如爱人的脸），会导致眼疲劳。研究人员指出，这是因为他们需要付出额外的脑力，去强行“解析”这种极其不自然的三维实体。
content_en: A recent study has found that concentrating on difficult off-screen objects, such as the faces of loved ones, causes eye strain in computer scientists. Researchers into the phenomenon cite the added concentration needed to "make sense" of such unnatural three dimensional objects.

content: A rolling disk gathers no MOS.
content_zh: 滚动的磁盘积不出MOS管。
content_en: A rolling disk gathers no MOS.

content: A successful [software] tool is one that was used to do something undreamed of by its author. — S. C. Johnson
content_zh: 一个成功的软件工具，就是被拿来做出了连它的作者当年做梦都不敢想的事情。——S·C·约翰逊
content_en: A successful [software] tool is one that was used to do something undreamed of by its author. — S. C. Johnson

content: A well-used door needs no oil on its hinges. A swift-flowing steam does not grow stagnant. Neither sound nor thoughts can travel through a vacuum. Software rots if not used. These are great mysteries. — Geoffrey James, "The Tao of Programming"
content_zh: 户枢不蠹，流水不腐。真空之中，声思皆绝。软件不用，久必生锈。此乃大道也。——杰弗里·詹姆斯，《编程之道》
content_en: A well-used door needs no oil on its hinges. A swift-flowing steam does not grow stagnant. Neither sound nor thoughts can travel through a vacuum. Software rots if not used. These are great mysteries. — Geoffrey James, "The Tao of Programming"

content: A year spent in artificial intelligence is enough to make one believe in God.
content_zh: 在人工智能领域泡上一年，足能让人直面赛博神迹，开始相信上帝了。
content_en: A year spent in artificial intelligence is enough to make one believe in God.

content: About the use of language: it is impossible to sharpen a pencil with a blunt ax. It is equally vain to try to do it with ten blunt axes instead. — Edsger Dijkstra
content_zh: 论及语言的使用：用钝斧头削铅笔是削不尖的；同样，妄想用十把钝斧头一起上达到目的，也只是徒劳。——艾兹格·迪杰斯特拉
content_en: About the use of language: it is impossible to sharpen a pencil with a blunt ax. It is equally vain to try to do it with ten blunt axes instead. — Edsger Dijkstra

content: Adding features does not necessarily increase functionality -- it just makes the manuals thicker.
content_zh: 加功能未必能增进实用性——它只会让说明书变得越来越厚。
content_en: Adding features does not necessarily increase functionality -- it just makes the manuals thicker.

content: Adding manpower to a late software project makes it later. — F. Brooks, "The Mythical Man-Month"
content_zh: 向进度落后的软件项目中增派人手，只会让项目延期得更厉害。——F·布鲁克斯，《人月神话》
content_en: Adding manpower to a late software project makes it later. — F. Brooks, "The Mythical Man-Month"

content: Whenever one person is found adequate to the discharge of a duty by close application thereto, it is worse execute by two persons and scarcely done at all if three or more are employed therein. — George Washington, 1732-1799
content_zh: 凡事一人专心即可办妥，若两人分担则效率堪忧，若三人或更多则形同虚设（正如多线程死锁或无限扯皮）。
content_en: Whenever one person is found adequate to the discharge of a duty by close application thereto, it is worse execute by two persons and scarcely done at all if three or more are employed therein. — George Washington, 1732-1799

content: Alan Turing thought about criteria to settle the question of whether machines can think, a question of which we now know that it is about as relevant as the question of whether submarines can swim. — Dijkstra
content_zh: 阿兰·图灵曾苦思冥想如何判断机器能否思考，而我们如今深知，这个问题就像在争论潜水艇会不会游泳一样毫无意义。
content_en: Alan Turing thought about criteria to settle the question of whether machines can think, a question of which we now know that it is about as relevant as the question of whether submarines can swim. — Dijkstra

content: Algol-60 surely must be regarded as the most important programming language yet developed. — T. Cheatham
content_zh: ALGOL-60 绝对称得上迄今为止最为重要的编程语言（虽然它已经成了老古董）。
content_en: Algol-60 surely must be regarded as the most important programming language yet developed. — T. Cheatham

content: All constants are variables.
content_zh: 世上本无常量，一切皆可变（只要你拥有内存修改权限）。
content_en: All constants are variables.

content: All parts should go together without forcing. You must remember that the parts you are reassembling were disassembled by you. Therefore, if you can't get them together again, there must be a reason. By all means, do not use a hammer. — IBM maintenance manual, 1925
content_zh: 所有零件装配时都应严丝合缝、无需暴力。请记住：这些零件本来就是你拆下来的。因此，如果你现在装不回去，必有蹊跷。无论如何，千万别上锤子！
content_en: All parts should go together without forcing. You must remember that the parts you are reassembling were disassembled by you. Therefore, if you can't get them together again, there must be a reason. By all means, do not use a hammer. — IBM maintenance manual, 1925

content: All programmers are playwrights and all computers are lousy actors.
content_zh: 所有的程序员都是剧作家，而所有的计算机都是演技稀烂的演员。
content_en: All programmers are playwrights and all computers are lousy actors.

content: "... all the good computer designs are bootlegged; the formally planned products, if they are built at all, are dogs!" — David E. Lundstrom, "A Few Good Men From Univac", MIT Press, 1987
content_zh: “……所有真正优秀的电脑设计都是‘偷渡’搞出来的；至于那些走正规流程规划出来的产品，要是真能造出来，那也全都是电子垃圾！”——大卫·E·伦德斯特罗姆，《Univac的几位好汉》
content_en: "... all the good computer designs are bootlegged; the formally planned products, if they are built at all, are dogs!" — David E. Lundstrom, "A Few Good Men From Univac", MIT Press, 1987

content: All the simple programs have been written.
content_zh: 所有简单的代码，都已经写完了。
content_en: All the simple programs have been written.

content: All your files have been destroyed (sorry). Paul.
content_zh: 你的文件已经全没了（不好意思）。保罗留。
content_en: All your files have been destroyed (sorry). Paul.

content: Almost anything derogatory you could say about today's software design would be accurate. — K. E. Iverson
content_zh: 无论你对当今的软件设计说多少损话、贴多少刻薄标签，全都是百分之百的实话。——K·E·艾弗森
content_en: Almost anything derogatory you could say about today's software design would be accurate. — K. E. Iverson

content: An Ada exception is when a routine gets in trouble and says 'Beam me up, Scotty'.
content_zh: Ada 语言里的异常（Exception）就好比一个子程序遇上了大麻烦，然后大喊一声：“斯科蒂，把我传上去！”
content_en: An Ada exception is when a routine gets in trouble and says 'Beam me up, Scotty'.

content: An adequate bootstrap is a contradiction in terms.
content_zh: “令人满意的自举（Bootstrap）”纯属逻辑自相矛盾。
content_en: An adequate bootstrap is a contradiction in terms.

content: An algorithm must be seen to be believed. — D. E. Knuth
content_zh: 算法必须跑起来，正如眼见方为实。—— D. E. 努德
content_en: An algorithm must be seen to be believed. — D. E. Knuth

content: An elephant is a mouse with an operating system.
content_zh: 大象不过是装了操作系统的老鼠。
content_en: An elephant is a mouse with an operating system.

content: An engineer is someone who does list processing in FORTRAN.
content_zh: 所谓工程师，就是能在 FORTRAN 里硬生生手办出链表处理的人。
content_en: An engineer is someone who does list processing in FORTRAN.

content: And it should be the law: If you use the word `paradigm' without knowing what the dictionary says it means, you go to jail. No exceptions. — David Jones
content_zh: 这必须立为一条铁律：谁要是连字典里对“范式”的定义都没搞懂就敢乱用这个词，直接送进局子，绝不特赦。—— 大卫·琼斯
content_en: And it should be the law: If you use the word `paradigm' without knowing what the dictionary says it means, you go to jail. No exceptions. — David Jones

content: And on the seventh day, He exited from append mode.
content_zh: 于是到了第七天，祂终于从追加模式（Append Mode）里退了出来。
content_en: And on the seventh day, He exited from append mode.

content: Another megabytes the dust.
content_zh: 又双叒叕有一兆字节化为尘土。
content_en: Another megabytes the dust.

content: Any given program will expand to fill available memory.
content_zh: 任何程序都会不断膨胀，直到榨干所有可用内存。
content_en: Any given program will expand to fill available memory.

content: Any given program, when running, is obsolete.
content_zh: 任何正在跑的代码，本质上都已经过时了。
content_en: Any given program, when running, is obsolete.

content: Any program which runs right is obsolete.
content_zh: 任何能正常跑起来的程序，其实都已经过时了。
content_en: Any program which runs right is obsolete.

content: Any programming language is at its best before it is implemented and used.
content_zh: 任何编程语言的高光时刻，都在它被落地实现和使用之前。
content_en: Any programming language is at its best before it is implemented and used.

content: Any sufficiently advanced bug is indistinguishable from a feature. — Rich Kulawiec
content_zh: 任何足够高级的 Bug，看起来都和特性一模一样。——里奇·库拉维克 (Rich Kulawiec)
content_en: Any sufficiently advanced bug is indistinguishable from a feature. — Rich Kulawiec

content: Anyone who has attended a USENIX conference in a fancy hotel can tell you that a sentence like "You're one of those computer people, aren't you?" is roughly equivalent to "Look, another amazingly mobile form of slime mold!" in the mouth of a hotel cocktail waitress. — Elizabeth Zwicky
content_zh: 参加过在豪华酒店举办的 USENIX 会议的人都知道，当酒店鸡尾酒服务员说出“你们这群搞电脑的，对吧？”这句话时，在她们眼里，这大概无异于在对一坨“瞧啊，又一种移动能力惊人的黏菌！”发出感叹。——伊丽莎白·茨维基 (Elizabeth Zwicky)
content_en: Anyone who has attended a USENIX conference in a fancy hotel can tell you that a sentence like "You're one of those computer people, aren't you?" is roughly equivalent to "Look, another amazingly mobile form of slime mold!" in the mouth of a hotel cocktail waitress. — Elizabeth Zwicky

content: APL hackers do it in the quad.
content_zh: APL黑客在四象限里搞定一切。
content_en: APL hackers do it in the quad.

content: APL is a mistake, carried through to perfection. It is the language of the future for the programming techniques of the past: it creates a new generation of coding bums. — Edsger W. Dijkstra, SIGPLAN Notices, Volume 17, Number 5
content_zh: APL就是一个错得极其完美的错误。它是用过去的代码编写艺术去实现未来的语言：硬生生培养出了新一代的代码乞丐。——艾兹格·W·迪杰斯特拉，《SIGPLAN Notices》第17卷第5期
content_en: APL is a mistake, carried through to perfection. It is the language of the future for the programming techniques of the past: it creates a new generation of coding bums. — Edsger W. Dijkstra, SIGPLAN Notices, Volume 17, Number 5

content: APL is a natural extension of assembler language programming; ...and is best for educational purposes. — A. Perlis
content_zh: APL是汇编语言编程的自然延伸；……而且最适合用来开展教育（或者虐人）。——A·佩利斯
content_en: APL is a natural extension of assembler language programming; ...and is best for educational purposes. — A. Perlis

content: APL is a write-only language. I can write programs in APL, but I can't read any of them. — Roy Keir
content_zh: APL是一门只能写不能读的语言。我用APL写得出代码，但我自己压根读不懂。——罗伊·基尔
content_en: APL is a write-only language. I can write programs in APL, but I can't read any of them. — Roy Keir

content: Are we running light with overbyte?
content_zh: 我们这是轻装上阵，还是被超长字节给撑爆了？
content_en: Are we running light with overbyte?

content: Around computers it is difficult to find the correct unit of time to measure progress. Some cathedrals took a century to complete. Can you imagine the grandeur and scope of a program that would take as long? — Epigrams in Programming, ACM SIGPLAN Sept. 1982
content_zh: 在计算机这行里，想找个合适的单位来衡量进度简直难如登天。有些大教堂花了一个世纪才盖好。你能想象一个得花这么久才能写完的程序，会有多宏伟、多庞大吗？——《编程警句》，ACM SIGPLAN，1982年9月
content_en: Around computers it is difficult to find the correct unit of time to measure progress. Some cathedrals took a century to complete. Can you imagine the grandeur and scope of a program that would take as long? — Epigrams in Programming, ACM SIGPLAN Sept. 1982

content: As a computer, I find your faith in technology amusing.
content_zh: 作为一台计算机，我觉得你们对技术的盲目信仰还挺好笑的。
content_en: As a computer, I find your faith in technology amusing.

content: As far as we know, our computer has never had an undetected error. — Weisert
content_zh: 据我们所知，我们的计算机从来没有发生过未被检测出来的错误。——韦瑟特
content_en: As far as we know, our computer has never had an undetected error. — Weisert

content: As in certain cults it is possible to kill a process if you know its true name. — Ken Thompson and Dennis M. Ritchie
content_zh: 就像某些神秘邪教一样，只要你知道一个进程的真名，你就能干掉它。——肯·汤普森与丹尼斯·里奇
content_en: As in certain cults it is possible to kill a process if you know its true name. — Ken Thompson and Dennis M. Ritchie

content: As long as there are ill-defined goals, bizarre bugs, and unrealistic schedules, there will be Real Programmers willing to jump in and Solve The Problem, saving the documentation for later.
content_zh: 只要还有模棱两可的目标、离奇诡异的 Bug 和不切实际的排期，就会有真正的程序员挺身而出解决问题，至于文档嘛——留着以后再说。
content_en: As long as there are ill-defined goals, bizarre bugs, and unrealistic schedules, there will be Real Programmers willing to jump in and Solve The Problem, saving the documentation for later.

content: As of next Thursday, UNIX will be flushed in favor of TOPS-10. Please update your programs.
content_zh: 从下周四开始，UNIX将被废弃，全面替换为 TOPS-10。请各位及时更新程序。
content_en: As of next Thursday, UNIX will be flushed in favor of TOPS-10. Please update your programs.

content: As of next Tuesday, C will be flushed in favor of COBOL. Please update your programs.
content_zh: 从下周二开始，C语言将被废弃，全面替换为 COBOL。请各位及时更新程序。
content_en: As of next Tuesday, C will be flushed in favor of COBOL. Please update your programs.

content: As of next week, passwords will be entered in Morse code.
content_zh: 下周起，密码统一改用摩斯密码输入。
content_en: As of next week, passwords will be entered in Morse code.

content: As the trials of life continue to take their toll, remember that there is always a future in Computer Maintenance. — National Lampoon, "Deteriorata"
content_zh: 当生活的摧残不断榨干你的灵魂时，别忘了——修电脑永远是你最后的退路。——《国家讽刺》杂志《德特拉塔》
content_en: As the trials of life continue to take their toll, remember that there is always a future in Computer Maintenance. — National Lampoon, "Deteriorata"

content: As Will Rogers would have said, "There is no such things as a free variable."
content_zh: 正如威尔·罗杰斯当年没说过的那样：“世上没有免费的自由变量。”
content_en: As Will Rogers would have said, "There is no such things as a free variable."

content: ASCII a stupid question, you get an EBCDIC answer.
content_zh: 问一个弱智问题，就收获一个老古董答案。
content_en: ASCII a stupid question, you get an EBCDIC answer.

content: ASHes to ASHes, DOS to DOS.
content_zh: 尘归尘，土归土，DOS 归 DOS，全线崩溃数一数。
content_en: ASHes to ASHes, DOS to DOS.

content: Ask not for whom the <CONTROL-G> tolls.
content_zh: 不要问丧钟为谁而鸣，<CONTROL-G> 哔它就在为你蜂鸣。
content_en: Ask not for whom the <CONTROL-G> tolls.

content: Assembly language experience is [important] for the maturity and understanding of how computers work that it provides. — D. Gries
content_zh: 汇编语言的经历对于理解计算机底层原理之所以重要，是因为它能让你直面惨淡的内存，正视淋漓的寄存器。—— D. 格里斯
content_en: Assembly language experience is [important] for the maturity and understanding of how computers work that it provides. — D. Gries

content: Asynchronous inputs are at the root of our race problems. — D. Winker and F. Prosser
content_zh: 异步输入，万恶之源，这就是我们的赛博“竞态”危机的根源。—— D. 温克尔 与 F.普罗瑟
content_en: Asynchronous inputs are at the root of our race problems. — D. Winker and F. Prosser

content: At first sight, the idea of any rules or principles being superimposed on the creative mind seems more likely to hinder than to help, but this is quite untrue in practice. Disciplined thinking focuses inspiration rather than blinkers it. — G. L. Glegg, "The Design of Design"
content_zh: 初看起来，给充满创造力的头脑套上规则或原则，似乎更像是束缚而非助力，但在现实中这完全是误解。有纪律的思考能聚焦灵感，而不是给它戴上眼罩。—— G. L. 格莱格，《设计的法则》
content_en: At first sight, the idea of any rules or principles being superimposed on the creative mind seems more likely to hinder than to help, but this is quite untrue in practice. Disciplined thinking focuses inspiration rather than blinkers it. — G. L. Glegg, "The Design of Design"

content: At Group L, Stoffel oversees six first-rate programmers, a managerial challenge roughly comparable to herding cats. — The Washington Post Magazine, 9 June, 1985
content_zh: 在 L 组，施托弗手下管着六位顶尖程序员——这种管理挑战，难度大概跟在猫堆里赶羊差不多。——《华盛顿邮报杂志》，1985年6月9日
content_en: At Group L, Stoffel oversees six first-rate programmers, a managerial challenge roughly comparable to herding cats. — The Washington Post Magazine, 9 June, 1985

content: At the source of every error which is blamed on the computer you will find at least two human errors, including the error of blaming it on the computer.
content_zh: 在每一个被甩锅给电脑的Bug背后，你至少能抓到两个人类的脑残操作，其中一个还包括把锅甩给电脑。
content_en: At the source of every error which is blamed on the computer you will find at least two human errors, including the error of blaming it on the computer.

content: Avoid strange women and temporary variables.
content_zh: 远离陌生的女人，别碰暂存的变量。
content_en: Avoid strange women and temporary variables.

content: Basic is a high level languish. APL is a high level anguish.
content_zh: BASIC 是一门高级语言（High-level language），而 APL 是一门高度痛苦的语言（High-level anguish）。
content_en: Basic is a high level languish. APL is a high level anguish.

content: BASIC is the Computer Science equivalent of `Scientific Creationism'.
content_zh: BASIC 之于计算机科学，就相当于“科学神创论”。
content_en: BASIC is the Computer Science equivalent of `Scientific Creationism'.

content: BASIC is to computer programming as QWERTY is to typing. — Seymour Papert
content_zh: BASIC 之于计算机编程，就如同 QWERTY 键盘之于打字。 —— 西摩尔·帕帕特
content_en: BASIC is to computer programming as QWERTY is to typing. — Seymour Papert

content: Be careful when a loop exits to the same place from side and bottom.
content_zh: 当循环（Loop）既能从侧面又能从底部跳出时，请务必小心。
content_en: Be careful when a loop exits to the same place from side and bottom.

content: Behind every great computer sits a skinny little geek.
content_zh: 每一个伟大电脑的背后，都坐着一个瘦小的极客。
content_en: Behind every great computer sits a skinny little geek.

content: Bell Labs Unix -- Reach out and grep someone.
content_zh: 贝尔实验室 Unix —— 伸出援手，grep 一下你的知己。
content_en: Bell Labs Unix -- Reach out and grep someone.

content: Beware of bugs in the above code; I have only proved it correct, not tried it. — Donald Knuth
content_zh: 谨防上述代码中的 Bug；我只证明了它的正确性，还没跑过呢。—— 德鲁斯·高德纳
content_en: Beware of bugs in the above code; I have only proved it correct, not tried it. — Donald Knuth

content: Beware of Programmers who carry screwdrivers. — Leonard Brandwein
content_zh: 随身带螺丝刀的程序员，碰到了得绕着走。—— 伦纳德·布兰德温
content_en: Beware of Programmers who carry screwdrivers. — Leonard Brandwein

content: Beware of the Turing Tar-pit in which everything is possible but nothing of interest is easy.
content_zh: 警惕图灵泥潭：在那里一切皆有可能，但想要做点有意思的事却难如登天。
content_en: Beware of the Turing Tar-pit in which everything is possible but nothing of interest is easy.

content: Blinding speed can compensate for a lot of deficiencies. — David Nichols
content_zh: 极致的速度足以掩盖无数的缺陷。—— 大卫·尼科尔斯
content_en: Blinding speed can compensate for a lot of deficiencies. — David Nichols

content: Both models are identical in performance, functional operation, and interface circuit details. The two models, however, are not compatible on the same communications line connection. — Bell System Technical Reference
content_zh: 两款型号在性能、功能操作以及接口电路细节上完全一致。然而，这两款型号在同一条通信线路连接上却无法兼容。—— 贝尔系统技术手册
content_en: Both models are identical in performance, functional operation, and interface circuit details. The two models, however, are not compatible on the same communications line connection. — Bell System Technical Reference

content: Brace yourselves. We're about to try something that borders on the unique: an actually rather serious technical book which is not only (gasp) vehemently anti-Solemn, but also (shudder) takes sides. I tend to think of it as `Constructive Snottiness.' — Mike Padlipsky, "Elements of Networking Style"
content_zh: 稳住，我们要整点微小却独特的活了：一本极其严肃的技术书，不仅（天呐）坚决反对装腔作势，而且（嘶——）还特么自带立场。我通常管这叫“建设性阴阳怪气”。—— 迈克·帕德利普斯基，《网络风格的要素》
content_en: Brace yourselves. We're about to try something that borders on the unique: an actually rather serious technical book which is not only (gasp) vehemently anti-Solemn, but also (shudder) takes sides. I tend to think of it as `Constructive Snottiness.' — Mike Padlipsky, "Elements of Networking Style"

content: Brain fried -- Core dumped
content_zh: 大脑烧干——核心已倾倒
content_en: Brain fried -- Core dumped

content: Breadth-first search is the bulldozer of science. — Randy Goebel
content_zh: 广度优先搜索是科学界的推土机。——兰迪·戈贝尔
content_en: Breadth-first search is the bulldozer of science. — Randy Goebel

content: Bringing computers into the home won't change either one, but may revitalize the corner saloon.
content_zh: 把电脑搬进家里，哪边都不会变，不过没准能让街角小酒馆再度火爆。
content_en: Bringing computers into the home won't change either one, but may revitalize the corner saloon.

content: Build a system that even a fool can use and only a fool will want to use it.
content_zh: 做一个连傻瓜都会用的系统，结果只有傻瓜才想用它。
content_en: Build a system that even a fool can use and only a fool will want to use it.

content: Building translators is good clean fun. — T. Cheatham
content_zh: 写编译器是既纯粹又好玩的正经事。——T·奇瑟姆
content_en: Building translators is good clean fun. — T. Cheatham

content: Bus error -- driver executed.
content_zh: 总线错误——司机被创飞。
content_en: Bus error -- driver executed.

content: Bus error -- please leave by the rear door.
content_zh: 总线错误——请从后门下车。
content_en: Bus error -- please leave by the rear door.

content: But in our enthusiasm, we could not resist a radical overhaul of the system, in which all of its major weaknesses have been exposed, analyzed, and replaced with new weaknesses. — Bruce Leverett, "Register Allocation in Optimizing Compilers"
content_zh: 但在强烈的热情驱使下，我们忍不住对系统进行了彻底的重构，暴露并分析了它的所有核心缺陷，然后用一堆全新的缺陷取而代之。——布鲁斯·莱弗雷特，《优化编译器中的寄存器分配》
content_en: But in our enthusiasm, we could not resist a radical overhaul of the system, in which all of its major weaknesses have been exposed, analyzed, and replaced with new weaknesses. — Bruce Leverett, "Register Allocation in Optimizing Compilers"

content: "But what we need to know is, do people want nasally-insertable computers?"
content_zh: “但我们需要知道的是，真有人想要能塞进鼻孔里的电脑吗？”
content_en: "But what we need to know is, do people want nasally-insertable computers?"

content: By long-standing tradition, I take this opportunity to savage other designers in the thin disguise of good, clean fun. — P. J. Plauger, "Computer Language", 1988, April Fool's column.
content_zh: 按照优良传统，我借此机会以“纯洁友好的玩笑”为薄面具，疯狂开团吐槽其他设计师。——P·J·普劳格，《计算机语言》，1988年愚人节专栏。
content_en: By long-standing tradition, I take this opportunity to savage other designers in the thin disguise of good, clean fun. — P. J. Plauger, "Computer Language", 1988, April Fool's column.

content: BYTE editors are people who separate the wheat from the chaff, and then carefully print the chaff.
content_zh: BYTE 杂志的编辑是一群去粗取精、最后把“粗”字精美排版印出来的人。
content_en: BYTE editors are people who separate the wheat from the chaff, and then carefully print the chaff.

content: C Code. C Code Run. Run, Code, RUN! PLEASE!!!!
content_zh: C 语言代码。C 语言代码运行。跑啊，代码，快跑！求求你了！！！！
content_en: C Code. C Code Run. Run, Code, RUN! PLEASE!!!!

content: C makes it easy for you to shoot yourself in the foot. C++ makes that harder, but when you do, it blows away your whole leg. — Bjarne Stroustrup
content_zh: C 语言让你轻而易举就能朝自己脚上开枪；C++ 没那么容易，但一旦你走火，它能直接把你的整条腿给轰没。—— 比亚尼·斯特劳斯特鲁普
content_en: C makes it easy for you to shoot yourself in the foot. C++ makes that harder, but when you do, it blows away your whole leg. — Bjarne Stroustrup

content: C'est magnifique, mais ce n'est pas l'Informatique. — Bosquet [on seeing the IBM 4341]
content_zh: 太绝了，但这根本不是计算机科学。—— 博斯凯（初见 IBM 4341 时有感）
content_en: C'est magnifique, mais ce n'est pas l'Informatique. — Bosquet [on seeing the IBM 4341]

content: C++ is the best example of second-system effect since OS/360.
content_zh: C++ 堪称自 OS/360 以来“第二系统效应”的最佳教科书级典范。
content_en: C++ is the best example of second-system effect since OS/360.

content: Calm down, it's *only* ones and zeroes.
content_zh: 淡定，不就是一堆 0 和 1 嘛。
content_en: Calm down, it's *only* ones and zeroes.

content_en: Can't open /usr/share/games/fortunes/fortunes. Lid stuck on cookie jar.

content_zh: CCI Power 6/40：单块主板，1MB缓存，外加满满的傲娇态度……
content_en: CCI Power 6/40: one board, a megabyte of cache, and an attitude...

content: Center meeting at 4pm in 2C-543.
content_zh: 中心会议定于今天下午4点，地点2C-543。
content_en: Center meeting at 4pm in 2C-543.

content: Civilization, as we know it, will end sometime this evening. See SYSNOTE tomorrow for more information.
content_zh: 我们所知的文明将在今天傍晚某个时候毁灭。详情请参阅明日的系统公告（SYSNOTE）。
content_en: Civilization, as we know it, will end sometime this evening. See SYSNOTE tomorrow for more information.

content: COBOL is for morons. — E. W. Dijkstra
content_zh: COBOL 是给笨蛋用的。—— E. W. 迪杰斯特拉
content_en: COBOL is for morons. — E. W. Dijkstra

content: Cobol programmers are down in the dumps.
content_zh: COBOL 程序员只能在垃圾堆里（或：悲伤低谷中）苦命搬砖了。
content_en: Cobol programmers are down in the dumps.

content: Coding is easy; All you do is sit staring at a terminal until the drops of blood form on your forehead.
content_zh: 写代码太简单了：你只需要坐在电脑前盯着终端，直到脑门急出冷汗、凝结成血珠。
content_en: Coding is easy; All you do is sit staring at a terminal until the drops of blood form on your forehead.

content: COMPASS [for the CDC-6000 series] is the sort of assembler one expects from a corporation whose president codes in octal. — J. N. Gray
content_zh: CDC-6000 系列的 COMPASS 汇编器，正是那种你能从一家“总裁直接手敲八进制代码”的公司里期待出来的产物。 —— J. N. Gray
content_en: COMPASS [for the CDC-6000 series] is the sort of assembler one expects from a corporation whose president codes in octal. — J. N. Gray

content: ... computer hardware progress is so fast. No other technology since civilization began has seen six orders of magnitude in performance-price gain in 30 years. — Fred Brooks
content_zh: ……计算机硬件的进步简直快得离谱。自从人类文明诞生以来，还没有哪项技术能在 30 年内实现性能价格比六个数量级的飙升。 —— 弗雷德·布鲁克斯
content_en: ... computer hardware progress is so fast. No other technology since civilization began has seen six orders of magnitude in performance-price gain in 30 years. — Fred Brooks

content: Computer programmers do it byte by byte.
content_zh: 程序员行事，向来都是字节配字节。
content_en: Computer programmers do it byte by byte.

content: Computer programmers never die, they just get lost in the processing.
content_zh: 程序员从不死去，他们只是迷失在无尽的进程处理中。
content_en: Computer programmers never die, they just get lost in the processing.

content: Computer programs expand so as to fill the core available.
content_zh: 计算机程序总是会无限膨胀，直到撑满所有可用的核心内存。
content_en: Computer programs expand so as to fill the core available.

content: Computer Science is merely the post-Turing decline in formal systems theory.
content_zh: 计算机科学，不过是形式系统理论在图灵之后的精神下坠罢了。
content_en: Computer Science is merely the post-Turing decline in formal systems theory.

content: Computer Science is the only discipline in which we view adding a new wing to a building as being maintenance — Jim Horning
content_zh: 计算机科学是唯一的这门学科：在里面，给大楼加盖个新侧翼竟然也能算作日常维护。——吉姆·霍宁
content_en: Computer Science is the only discipline in which we view adding a new wing to a building as being maintenance — Jim Horning

content: Computers are not intelligent. They only think they are.
content_zh: 计算机一点都不聪明，它们只是觉得自己很聪明。
content_en: Computers are not intelligent. They only think they are.

content: Computers are unreliable, but humans are even more unreliable. Any system which depends on human reliability is unreliable. — Gilb
content_zh: 机器并不可靠，但人类比机器更不可靠。任何依赖人类靠谱程度的系统，注定都是不靠谱的。——吉尔布
content_en: Computers are unreliable, but humans are even more unreliable. Any system which depends on human reliability is unreliable. — Gilb

content: Computers are useless. They can only give you answers. — Pablo Picasso
content_zh: 计算机屁用没有，它们只会给你答案。——巴勃罗·毕加索
content_en: Computers are useless. They can only give you answers. — Pablo Picasso

content: Computers can figure out all kinds of problems, except the things in the world that just don't add up.
content_zh: 计算机能算出形形色色的难题，唯独算不明白这个世界上那些根本对不平的账。
content_en: Computers can figure out all kinds of problems, except the things in the world that just don't add up.

content: Computers don't actually think. You just think they think. (We think.)
content_zh: 电脑其实不会思考，只是你以为它们会思考。（大概吧，我们也开始怀疑了。）
content_en: Computers don't actually think. You just think they think. (We think.)

content: Computers will not be perfected until they can compute how much more than the estimate the job will cost.
content_zh: 直到电脑能精确算出一个项目究竟会比预算超支多少倍之前，它们就谈不上完美。
content_en: Computers will not be perfected until they can compute how much more than the estimate the job will cost.

content: Conceptual integrity in turn dictates that the design must proceed from one mind, or from a very small number of agreeing resonant minds. — Frederick Brooks Jr., "The Mythical Man Month"
content_zh: 从另一个角度来看，概念完整性要求设计必须出自单一头脑，或是少数几个心有灵犀、意见高度一致的大脑。—— 弗雷德里克·布鲁克斯，《人月神话》
content_en: Conceptual integrity in turn dictates that the design must proceed from one mind, or from a very small number of agreeing resonant minds. — Frederick Brooks Jr., "The Mythical Man Month"

content: Congratulations! You are the one-millionth user to log into our system. If there's anything special we can do for you, anything at all, don't hesitate to ask!
content_zh: 恭喜！您是登录本系统的第一百万位用户。只要有任何我们能为您效劳的地方，哪怕只有一点点，请尽管开口！
content_en: Congratulations! You are the one-millionth user to log into our system. If there's anything special we can do for you, anything at all, don't hesitate to ask!

content: Couldn't we jury-rig the cat to act as an audio switch, and have it yell at people to save their core images before logging them out? I'm sure the cattle prod would be effective in this regard. In any case, a traverse mounted iguana, while more perverted, gives better traction, not to mention being easier to stake.
content_zh: 咱们难道不能临时把那只猫改装成音频开关，让它在把用户登出前大喊大叫提醒大家保存核心镜像吗？我敢说电击棒在这方面绝对好使。不管怎么说，横向安装的鬣蜥虽然变态了点，但抓地力更好，而且更容易固定。
content_en: Couldn't we jury-rig the cat to act as an audio switch, and have it yell at people to save their core images before logging them out? I'm sure the cattle prod would be effective in this regard. In any case, a traverse mounted iguana, while more perverted, gives better traction, not to mention being easier to stake.

content: Counting in binary is just like counting in decimal -- if you are all thumbs. — Glaser and Way
content_zh: 二进制数数跟十进制数数完全一样——前提是你满手都是大拇指。—— 格拉泽与韦伊
content_en: Counting in binary is just like counting in decimal -- if you are all thumbs. — Glaser and Way

content: Counting in octal is just like counting in decimal--if you don't use your thumbs. — Tom Lehrer
content_zh: 八进制数其实和十进制数一模一样——只要你不用大拇指算数就行。——汤姆·勒勒
content_en: Counting in octal is just like counting in decimal--if you don't use your thumbs. — Tom Lehrer

content: [Crash programs] fail because they are based on the theory that, with nine women pregnant, you can get a baby a month. — Wernher von Braun
content_zh: [献礼工程/百日会战] 之所以失败，是因为它们坚信：只要让九个女人同时怀孕，就能在一个月里生出孩子。——韦恩赫尔·冯·布劳恩
content_en: [Crash programs] fail because they are based on the theory that, with nine women pregnant, you can get a baby a month. — Wernher von Braun

content_zh: 昨日交付，今日写码，明日思考（指明天再说）。

content_en: Did you know that for the price of a 280-Z you can buy two Z-80's? — P. J. Plauger

content: Disk crisis, please clean up!
content_zh: 磁盘快炸了，赶紧清理一下！
content_en: Disk crisis, please clean up!

content: Disraeli was pretty close: actually, there are Lies, Damn lies, Statistics, Benchmarks, and Delivery dates.
content_zh: 迪斯雷利说得挺接近事实了：世上其实有谎言、该死的谎言、统计数据、跑分测试，以及项目交付日期。
content_en: Disraeli was pretty close: actually, there are Lies, Damn lies, Statistics, Benchmarks, and Delivery dates.

content: Do not meddle in the affairs of troff, for it is subtle and quick to anger.
content_zh: 莫去插手 troff 的事务，因为它不仅深奥玄妙，而且极其暴躁易怒。
content_en: Do not meddle in the affairs of troff, for it is subtle and quick to anger.

content: Do not simplify the design of a program if a way can be found to make it complex and wonderful.
content_zh: 只要能想方设法把它搞得既复杂又惊艳，就千万别去简化程序的架构。
content_en: Do not simplify the design of a program if a way can be found to make it complex and wonderful.

content: Do not use the blue keys on this terminal.
content_zh: 千万别按这台终端机上的蓝色键。
content_en: Do not use the blue keys on this terminal.

content: Do you guys know what you're doing, or are you just hacking?
content_zh: 你们这是在运筹帷幄，还是纯纯在瞎jb乱敲（Hacking）？
content_en: Do you guys know what you're doing, or are you just hacking?

content: Documentation is like sex: when it is good, it is very, very good; and when it is bad, it is better than nothing. — Dick Brandon
content_zh: 文档就像性爱：好的时候，简直爽到飞起；坏的时候……好歹也比完全没有强。——迪克·布兰登
content_en: Documentation is like sex: when it is good, it is very, very good; and when it is bad, it is better than nothing. — Dick Brandon

content: Documentation is the castor oil of programming. Managers know it must be good because the programmers hate it so much.
content_zh: 文档就是编程界的蓖麻油。经理们知道这玩意儿绝对是个宝，因为程序员恨它恨得牙痒痒。 —— 迪克·布兰登
content_en: Documentation is the castor oil of programming. Managers know it must be good because the programmers hate it so much.

content: Does a good farmer neglect a crop he has planted? Does a good teacher overlook even the most humble student? Does a good father allow a single child to starve? Does a good programmer refuse to maintain his code? — Geoffrey James, "The Tao of Programming"
content_zh: 好农夫会荒废自己种下的庄稼吗？好老师会忽视最卑微的学生吗？好父亲会眼睁睁看着骨肉挨饿吗？那好程序员怎么能拒绝维护自己写的老代码呢？——杰弗里·詹姆斯《编程之道》
content_en: Does a good farmer neglect a crop he has planted? Does a good teacher overlook even the most humble student? Does a good father allow a single child to starve? Does a good programmer refuse to maintain his code? — Geoffrey James, "The Tao of Programming"

content: Don't compare floating point numbers solely for equality.
content_zh: 莫拿浮点数直接比相等，否则你会死得很惨（老老实实用 $\epsilon$ 容差啊喂）。
content_en: Don't compare floating point numbers solely for equality.

content: Don't get suckered in by the comments -- they can be terribly misleading. Debug only code. — Dave Storer
content_zh: 别被注释给骗了——它们满嘴跑火车。只有代码不会背叛你，信代码，得永生。——戴夫·斯托雷尔
content_en: Don't get suckered in by the comments -- they can be terribly misleading. Debug only code. — Dave Storer

content: Don't hit the keys so hard, it hurts.
content_zh: 别把键盘砸得那么狠，它会疼的（键盘：我真的会谢）。
content_en: Don't hit the keys so hard, it hurts.

content: Don't sweat it -- it's only ones and zeros. — P. Skelly
content_zh: 别慌，全是 1 和 0 罢了。—— P. 斯凯利
content_en: Don't sweat it -- it's only ones and zeros. — P. Skelly

content: DOS Air: All the passengers go out onto the runway, grab hold of the plane, push it until it gets in the air, hop on, jump off when it hits the ground again. Then they grab the plane again, push it back into the air, hop on, et cetera.
content_zh: DOS 航空：所有乘客走到跑道上，抓住飞机推到半空中，跳上去，落地后再跳下来。然后大家再抓住飞机推回空中，跳上去，以此类推。
content_en: DOS Air: All the passengers go out onto the runway, grab hold of the plane, push it until it gets in the air, hop on, jump off when it hits the ground again. Then they grab the plane again, push it back into the air, hop on, et cetera.

content: Due to lack of disk space, this fortune database has been discontinued.
content_zh: 由于磁盘空间不足，本条运势数据库已被迫下线（缘分已尽，请充值硬盘）。
content_en: Due to lack of disk space, this fortune database has been discontinued.

content: Each new user of a new system uncovers a new class of bugs. — Kernighan
content_zh: 每一个新系统的新用户，都会解锁一个全新维度的 Bug。—— 克尼汉
content_en: Each new user of a new system uncovers a new class of bugs. — Kernighan

content: /earth is 98% full ... please delete anyone you can.
content_zh: /地球存储空间已满 98%……请抓紧删掉几个能删的人。
content_en: /earth is 98% full ... please delete anyone you can.

content: /earth: file system full.
content_zh: /地球：文件系统已爆满。
content_en: /earth: file system full.

content: Error in operator: add beer
content_zh: 操作员运行报错：缺失参数 add beer
content_en: Error in operator: add beer

content: Established technology tends to persist in the face of new technology. — G. Blaauw, one of the designers of System 360
content_zh: 成熟的技术往往会在新技术的冲击下选择顽强续命。—— G. Blaauw，System 360 设计师之一
content_en: Established technology tends to persist in the face of new technology. — G. Blaauw, one of the designers of System 360

content: <<<<< EVACUATION ROUTE <<<<<
content_en: <<<<< EVACUATION ROUTE <<<<<

content: Even bytes get lonely for a little bit.
content_zh: 哪怕是双数（或字节），偶尔也会渴望一点点单身（或孤单）的滋味。
content_en: Even bytes get lonely for a little bit.

content: Every program has at least one bug and can be shortened by at least one instruction -- from which, by induction, one can deduce that every program can be reduced to one instruction which doesn't work.
content_zh: 每个程序至少有一个Bug，且至少可以缩短一条指令——由此用数学归纳法可知，任何程序最终都可以简化为一条无法运行的指令。
content_en: Every program has at least one bug and can be shortened by at least one instruction -- from which, by induction, one can deduce that every program can be reduced to one instruction which doesn't work.

content: Every program is a part of some other program, and rarely fits.
content_zh: 每个程序都是别的程序的一部分，而且通常严丝合缝地……对不上。
content_en: Every program is a part of some other program, and rarely fits.

content: Every Solidarity center had piles and piles of paper ... everyone was eating paper and a policeman was at the door. Now all you have to do is bend a disk. — A member of the outlawed Polish trade union, Solidarity, commenting on the benefits of using computers in support of their movement.
content_zh: 过去每个团结工会总部都堆满了纸……大家都快把纸当饭吃了，警察还在门口守着。现在倒好，只需把磁盘弯一下就行了。——波兰被禁工会“团结工会”成员对使用计算机支持其运动之便利的评价
content_en: Every Solidarity center had piles and piles of paper ... everyone was eating paper and a policeman was at the door. Now all you have to do is bend a disk. — A member of the outlawed Polish trade union, Solidarity, commenting on the benefits of using computers in support of their movement.

content: Everybody needs a little love sometime; stop hacking and fall in love!
content_zh: 谁都需要一点爱，别整天敲代码了，去谈场恋爱吧！
content_en: Everybody needs a little love sometime; stop hacking and fall in love!

content: Everyone can be taught to sculpt: Michelangelo would have had to be taught how not to. So it is with the great programmers.
content_zh: 人人都可以学会雕刻：米开朗琪罗当初得学的是如何不去雕刻。伟大的程序员也是如此。
content_en: Everyone can be taught to sculpt: Michelangelo would have had to be taught how not to. So it is with the great programmers.

content: Logic doesn't apply to the real world. — Marvin Minsky
content_zh: 逻辑在现实世界里根本行不通。——马文·明斯基
content_en: Logic doesn't apply to the real world. — Marvin Minsky

content: Sendmail may be safely run set-user-id to root. — Eric Allman, "Sendmail Installation Guide"
content_zh: Sendmail 安全运行在 root 的 set-user-id 下是完全没问题的。——埃里克·奥尔曼，《Sendmail 安装指南》（注：这是网络安全史上的经典“Flag”）
content_en: Sendmail may be safely run set-user-id to root. — Eric Allman, "Sendmail Installation Guide"

content: The Analytical Engine weaves Algebraical patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves. — Ada Augusta, Countess of Lovelace, the first programmer
content_zh: 分析机编织代数的图案，正如提花织机编织花朵和绿叶。——阿达·奥古斯塔，洛夫莱斯伯爵夫人（人类首位程序员）
content_en: The Analytical Engine weaves Algebraical patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves. — Ada Augusta, Countess of Lovelace, the first programmer

content: The meta-Turing test counts a thing as intelligent if it seeks to devise and apply Turing tests to objects of its own creation. — Lew Mammel, Jr.
content_zh: 元图灵测试认为：如果一个事物试图为其自己创造的对象设计并应用图灵测试，那么它就是智能的。——小刘·马梅尔
content_en: The meta-Turing test counts a thing as intelligent if it seeks to devise and apply Turing tests to objects of its own creation. — Lew Mammel, Jr.

content: The problem with engineers is that they tend to cheat in order to get results. The problem with mathematicians is that they tend to work on toy problems in order to get results. The problem with program verifiers is that they tend to cheat at toy problems in order to get results.
content_zh: 工程师的问题在于，他们为了搞出结果往往会作弊；数学家的问题在于，他们为了搞出结果往往只研究玩具级的问题；程序验证者的问题在于，他们为了搞出结果往往在玩具级问题上作弊。
content_en: The problem with engineers is that they tend to cheat in order to get results. The problem with mathematicians is that they tend to work on toy problems in order to get results. The problem with program verifiers is that they tend to cheat at toy problems in order to get results.

content: The proof that IBM didn't invent the car is that it has a steering wheel and an accelerator instead of spurs and ropes, to be compatible with a horse. — Jac Goudsmit
content_zh: 证明 IBM 没有发明汽车的铁证：它配的是方向盘和油门，而不是马刺和缰绳——这样才能和马保持兼容。——雅克·古德斯米特
content_en: The proof that IBM didn't invent the car is that it has a steering wheel and an accelerator instead of spurs and ropes, to be compatible with a horse. — Jac Goudsmit

content: They seem to have learned the habit of cowering before authority even when not actually threatened. How very nice for authority. I decided not to learn this particular lesson. — Richard Stallman
content_zh: 这帮人似乎连没挨威胁时都在权威面前学会了瑟瑟发抖。权威看了直呼内行。我决定不学这门“必修课”。——理查德·斯托曼
content_en: They seem to have learned the habit of cowering before authority even when not actually threatened. How very nice for authority. I decided not to learn this particular lesson. — Richard Stallman

content: Those parts of the system that you can hit with a hammer (not advised) are called hardware; those program instructions that you can only curse at are called software. — Levitating Trains and Kamikaze Genes: Technological Literacy for the 1990's.
content_zh: 系统中那些你可以用锤子砸（虽然不建议）的部分叫硬件；那些只能让你疯狂口吐芬芳的程序指令叫软件。——《列车悬浮与神风基因：90年代的技术素养》
content_en: Those parts of the system that you can hit with a hammer (not advised) are called hardware; those program instructions that you can only curse at are called software. — Levitating Trains and Kamikaze Genes: Technological Literacy for the 1990's.

content: Unix gives you just enough rope to hang yourself -- and then a couple of more feet, just to be sure. — Eric Allman ... We make rope. — Rob Gingell on Sun Microsystem's new virtual memory.
content_zh: Unix 塞给你的绳子刚刚好够你把自己吊死——而且为了保险起见，还多送了你两英尺。——埃里克·阿尔曼……我们造的就是绳子。——罗布·金格尔谈 Sun 微系统的全新虚拟内存。
content_en: Unix gives you just enough rope to hang yourself -- and then a couple of more feet, just to be sure. — Eric Allman ... We make rope. — Rob Gingell on Sun Microsystem's new virtual memory.

content: UNIX was half a billion (500000000) seconds old on Tue Nov 5 00:53:20 1985 GMT (measuring since the time(2) epoch). — Andy Tanenbaum
content_zh: 按 time(2) 的纪元计算，UNIX 在 1985 年 11 月 5 日格林尼治标准时间 00:53:20 刚好活了五亿（500000000）秒。——安德鲁·塔能鲍姆
content_en: UNIX was half a billion (500000000) seconds old on Tue Nov 5 00:53:20 1985 GMT (measuring since the time(2) epoch). — Andy Tanenbaum

content: "We are on the verge: Today our program proved Fermat's next-to-last theorem." — Epigrams in Programming, ACM SIGPLAN Sept. 1982
content_zh: “我们正处于重大突破的边缘：今天，我们的程序证明了费马的倒数第二个定理。”——《编程警句》，ACM SIGPLAN 1982年9月
content_en: "We are on the verge: Today our program proved Fermat's next-to-last theorem." — Epigrams in Programming, ACM SIGPLAN Sept. 1982

content: You have a massage (from the Swedish prime minister).
content_zh: 你有一条马杀鸡（来自瑞典首相）。
content_en: You have a massage (from the Swedish prime minister).

content: You must realize that the computer has it in for you. The irrefutable proof of this is that the computer always does what you tell it to do.
content_zh: 你必须意识到，电脑是在故意跟你作对。这无可辩驳的证据就是：电脑总是严格执行你下达的指令。
content_en: You must realize that the computer has it in for you. The irrefutable proof of this is that the computer always does what you tell it to do.

content: 3 logicians walk into a bar. The bartender asks: Do all of you want a drink? The first logician says "I don't know". The second logician says "I don't know" the third logician says "Yes!"
content_zh: 三个数理逻辑学家走进酒吧。酒保问：“你们所有人都想来一杯吗？”第一个逻辑学家说：“我不知道。”第二个逻辑学家说：“我不知道。”第三个逻辑学家说：“是的！”
content_en: 3 logicians walk into a bar. The bartender asks: Do all of you want a drink? The first logician says "I don't know". The second logician says "I don't know" the third logician says "Yes!"

content: Artificial intelligence usually beats real stupidity.
content_zh: 人工智能通常能战胜纯天然的愚蠢。
content_en: Artificial intelligence usually beats real stupidity.

content: Programming today is a race between software engineers striving to build bigger and better idiot-proof programs and the Universe trying to produce bigger and better idiots. So far the Universe is winning.
content_zh: 如今的编程是一场竞赛：软件工程苦心孤诣地开发更强、更完美的防呆程序，而宇宙则在源源不断地批量制造更强大、更高级的呆子。到目前为止，宇宙稳操胜券。
content_en: Programming today is a race between software engineers striving to build bigger and better idiot-proof programs and the Universe trying to produce bigger and better idiots. So far the Universe is winning.

content: Enter any 11-digit prime number to continue.
content_zh: 请输入任意 11 位素数以继续。
content_en: Enter any 11-digit prime number to continue.

content: An infinite crowd of mathematicians enters a bar. The first one orders a pint... the second one a half pint... the third one a quarter pint… “I understand”... says the bartender – and pours two pints.
content_zh: 无限多名数学家走进一家酒吧。第一个点了一品脱……第二个点了半品脱……第三个点了四分之一品脱……酒保说：“我懂了”——然后倒了两品脱。
content_en: An infinite crowd of mathematicians enters a bar. The first one orders a pint... the second one a half pint... the third one a quarter pint… “I understand”... says the bartender – and pours two pints.

content: If, by some incredible space-time paradox, Chuck Norris would ever fight himself, he'd win. Period.
content_zh: 要是发生某种不可思议的时空悖论，查克·诺里斯和自己打起来了，那赢的肯定还是他。没商量。
content_en: If, by some incredible space-time paradox, Chuck Norris would ever fight himself, he'd win. Period.

content: In the movie "The Matrix", Chuck Norris is the Matrix. If you pay close attention in the green "falling code" scenes, you can make out the faint texture of his beard.
content_zh: 在电影《黑客帝国》里，查克·诺里斯就是母体本身。如果你在那些绿色“代码雨”的场景里仔细看，还能隐约看出他胡子的纹理。
content_en: In the movie "The Matrix", Chuck Norris is the Matrix. If you pay close attention in the green "falling code" scenes, you can make out the faint texture of his beard.

content: Chuck Norris doesn't bug hunt as that signifies a probability of failure, he goes bug killing.
content_zh: 查克·诺里斯从不“捉虫”（Debug），因为那暗示着失败的概率；他直接去“灭虫”。
content_en: Chuck Norris doesn't bug hunt as that signifies a probability of failure, he goes bug killing.
